sort direction '{other}' (want asc or desc)\"\n                    )))\n                }\n            };\n            fields.push(KeyField { field, order });\n        }\n        if fields.is_empty() {\n            fields.push(KeyField {\n                field: 0,\n                order: Order::Asc,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(KeySpec { fields, delim })\n    }\n\n    /// Extract every component of the key from one record.\n    pub fn extract<'a>(&self, line: &'a [u8]) -> Vec<&'a [u8]> {\n        self.fields\n            .iter()\n            .map(|f| extract_field(line, f.field, self.delim))\n            .collect()\n    }\n\n    /// Compare extracted keys (without the sequence tie-break).\n    pub fn compare_keys(&self, a: &[&[u8]], b: &[&[u8]]) -> std::cmp::Ordering {\n Order::Desc {\n                    cmp.reverse()\n                } else {\n                    cmp\n                };\n            }\n        }\n        std::cmp::Ordering::Equal\n    }\n}\n\n/// Slice out field `n` (0 = whole line, 1 = first column, ...).\n/// Missing columns are an empty slice.\npub fn extract_field(line: &[u8], n: usize, delim: u8) -> &[u8] {\n    if n == 0 {\n        return line;\n    }\n    let mut col = 1usize;\n    let mut start = 0usize;\n    for (i, &b) in line.iter().enumerate() {\n        if b == delim {\n            if col == n {\n                return &line[start..i];\n            }\n            col += 1;\n            start = i + 1;\n        }\n    }\n    if col == n {\n        &line[start..]\n    } else {\n        &[][..]\n    }\n}\n\n/// Number of line bytes that must be buffered before every requested field is\n/// known, so giant lines can have their key resolved while the rest streams\n/// from disk. It is the position just past the start of the last needed\n/// column: delimiter index of the (max_field-1)'th delimiter + 1.\n///\n/// Returns `None` if all requested fields are present within `line`'s length;\n/// in that case the caller still needs to find where the *last present*\n/// column ends, which callers resolve via [`prefix_end_for_key`] (the whole\n/// line when field 0 is requested).\npub fn key_needs_whole_line(spec: &KeySpec) -> bool {\n    spec.fields.iter().any(|f| f.field == 0)\n}\n\n/// Given a prefix buffer `buf` of a single line (not including `\\n`), decide\n/// whether it already contains all requested key columns.\npub fn prefix_has_key(spec: &KeySpec, buf: &[u8]) -> bool {\n    if key_needs_whole_line(spec) {\n        false // whole-line key needs the entire record by definition\n    } else {\n        let max_field = spec.fields.iter().map(|f| f.field).max().unwrap_or(0);\n        // Number of delimiters seen: field N starts after N-1 delimiters, and\n        // the field extends until the next delimiter or newline. max_field, which is complete once we\n        // have seen at least max_field delimiters (the next column began) ...\n        delim_count >= max_field\n        // ... or the line has ended (scanner signals that separately by\n        // finalizing the record).\n    }\n}\n\n/// Comparator on `(key, seq)`: key first per spec, seq ascending for stability.\npub fn compare_records(\n    spec: a_seq.cmp(&b_seq),\n        other => other,\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn field_extraction() {\n        let line = b\"alpha,beta,gamma\";\n b\"2,a\", b\"1,m\"];\n        // group asc, name desc\n        let spec = KeySpec::parse(\"1:asc,2:desc\", b',').unwrap();\n        let mut indexed: Vec<(Vec<Vec<u8>>, usize)> = rows\n On-disk run-segment format and its sequential writer/reader.\n//!\n//! # Disk format\n//!\n//! A run is one *committed* (renamed + fsynced) file:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! magic   : 8 bytes  = b\"EXTSORT\\x01\"\n//! records : zero or more records, each one or more *chunks*\n//! trailer : u64 LE record count\n//! tail    : 8 bytes  = b\"ENDRUN\\x01\\x00\"\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Chunk framing (9 bytes header + payload):\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! flags   : u8        bit0 = FIRST chunk of a record\n//!                     bit1 = CONT  — more chunks follow this one\n//!                     (single-chunk record: FIRST, no CONT;\n//!                      last chunk of multi-chunk record: neither)\n//! length  : u32 LE    payload length (<= CHUNK_MAX = 16 KiB)\n//! crc32   : u32 LE    CRC-32/IEEE of the payload bytes\n//! payload : `length` bytes\n//! ```\n//!\n//! The FIRST chunk's payload is:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! u64 LE   seq             original input sequence number (stability)\n//! u8       nl              1 if the record ended with '\\n' in the input\n//! u32 LE   key_count       number of key components\n//! per key:\n//!   u32 LE key_len\n//!   bytes  key bytes\n//! bytes    value prefix (the record's own bytes, excluding '\\n')\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Later chunks contain only continuation value bytes. This layout lets a\n//! record of *unbounded* length be spilled with bounded memory: a giant line\n//! is streamed chunk-by-chunk while its (bounded) key lives in the head.\n//!\n//! Integrity: every chunk carries a CRC over its payload; the reader verifies\n//! it as the payload is consumed. The trailer repeats the record count, so a\n//! torn tail is detected. Header magic / tail magic detect wrong or\n//! truncated files.\n\nuse std::io;\n\nuse crate::crc::Crc;\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::io::VFile;\n\n/// Magic prefix of every run file.\npub const MAGIC: &[u8; 8] = b\"EXTSORT\\x01\";\n/// Magic suffix written after the record count.\npub const TAIL: &[u8; 8] = b\"ENDRUN\\x01\\x00\";\n\n/// Maximum payload bytes in one chunk.\npub const CHUNK_MAX: usize = 16 * 1024;\n/// Value bytes carried in a giant record's FIRST chunk.\npub const GIANT_HEAD_VALUE: usize = 8 * 1024;\n\nconst FLAG_FIRST: u8 = 0x01;\nconst FLAG_CONT: u8 = 0x02;\n\nconst HEADER_LEN: usize = 9;\n\n/// Trait used by [`RunWriter::write_giant`] to pull the remainder of a record\n/// that is too large to hold in memory. Implemented by the input scanner.\npub trait GiantDrain {\n    /// Copy up to `want` bytes of the current record's remainder into `buf`\n    /// (`buf.len() == want`). Returns bytes copied; fewer than `want` means the\n    /// record (and its trailing newline) has been fully consumed. May return\n    /// fewer than `want` even mid-record; callers loop.\n    fn pull(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> Result<usize>;\n}\n\n/// Sequential run writer. Drop without [`RunWriter::commit`] leaves a\n/// `*.tmp` file that recovery ignores.\npub struct RunWriter {\n    file: Box<dyn VFile>,\n    tmp_path: String,\n    final_path: String,\n    records: u64,\n    crc: Crc,\n}\n\nimpl RunWriter {\n    /// Start a new run at `<dir>/<name>.run.tmp`.\n    pub fn create(vfs: &dyn crate::io::Vfs, dir: &str, name: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let tmp_path = format!(\"{dir}/{name}.run.tmp\");\n        let final_path = format!(\"{dir}/{name}.run\");\n        let mut file = vfs.create(&tmp_path)?;\n        file.write_all(MAGIC)?;\n        Ok(RunWriter {\n            file,\n            tmp_path,\n            final_path,\n            records: 0,\n            crc: Crc::new(),\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn record_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.records\n    }\n\n    pub fn tmp_path(&self) -> &str {\n        &self.tmp_path\n    }\n\n    pub fn final_path(&self) -> &str {\n        &self.final_path\n    }\n\n    fn write_chunk(&mut self, flags: u8, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        debug_assert!(payload.len() <= CHUNK_MAX);\n        let mut crc = Crc::new();\n        crc.write(payload);\n        let mut hdr = [0u8; HEADER_LEN];\n        hdr[0] = flags;\n        hdr[1..5].copy_from_slice(&(payload.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());\n        hdr[5..9].copy_from_slice(&crc.finish().to_le_bytes());\n        self.file.write_all(&hdr)?;\n        self.file.write_all(payload)?;\n        self.crc.write(payload);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn encode_head(\n        seq: u64,\n        nl: bool,\n        keys: &[Vec<u8>],\n        value_prefix: &[u8],\n    ) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let mut p = Vec::with_capacity(\n            8 + 1 + 4 + keys.iter().map(|k| 4 + k.len()).sum::<usize>() + value_prefix.len(),\n        );\n        p.extend_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());\n        p.push(if nl { 1 } else { 0 });\n        p.extend_from_slice(&(keys.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());\n        for k in keys {\n            p.extend_from_slice(&(k.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());\n            p.extend_from_slice(k);\n        }\n        p.extend_from_slice(value_prefix);\n        p\n    }\n\n    /// Write one record that is fully resident in `value`.\n    pub fn write_record(&mut self, seq: u64, nl: bool, keys: &[Vec<u8>], value: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        if value.len()\n            <= CHUNK_MAX.saturating_sub(8 + 1 + 4 + keys.iter().map(|k| 4 + k.len()).sum::<usize>())\n        {\n            let payload = Self::encode_head(seq, nl, keys, value);\n            self.write_chunk(FLAG_FIRST, &payload)?;\n        } else {\n            // Defensive: even a fully-buffered huge value streams via chunks.\n            let head_cap = CHUNK_MAX\n                - (8 + 1 + 4 + keys.iter().map(|k| 4 + k.len()).sum::<usize>());\n            let take = head_cap.min(value.len());\n            let payload = Self::encode_head(seq, nl, keys, &value[..take]);\n            self.write_chunk(FLAG_FIRST | FLAG_CONT, &payload)?;\n            let mut rest = &value[take..];\n            while !rest.is_empty() {\n                let n = CHUNK_MAX.min(rest.len());\n                let last = n == rest.len();\n                self.write_chunk(if last { 0 } else { FLAG_CONT }, &rest[..n])?;\n                rest = &rest[n..];\n            }\n        }\n        self.records += 1;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Stream a giant record: head holds seq/keys plus up to\n    /// [`GIANT_HEAD_VALUE`] value bytes; the rest is pulled from `drain`.\n    pub fn write_giant(\n        &mut self,\n        seq: u64,\n        nl: bool,\n        keys: &[Vec<u8>],\n        prefix: &[u8],\n        drain: &mut dyn GiantDrain,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        debug_assert!(prefix.len() <= GIANT_HEAD_VALUE);\n        let overhead = 8 + 1 + 4 + keys.iter().map(|k| 4 + k.len()).sum::<usize>();\n        let head_budget = CHUNK_MAX.saturating_sub(overhead);\n        // Fill the first chunk beyond `prefix` from the drain when possible.\n        let mut first = Self::encode_head(seq, nl, keys, prefix);\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; CHUNK_MAX];\n        while first.len() < head_budget + overhead {\n            let want = (head_budget + overhead - first.len()).min(buf.len());\n            let n = drain.pull(&mut buf[..want])?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                break;\n            }\n            first.extend_from_slice(&buf[..n]);\n        }\n        let more_after = first.len() == head_budget + overhead;\n        self.write_chunk(\n            if more_after { FLAG_FIRST | FLAG_CONT } else { FLAG_FIRST },\n            &first,\n        )?;\n        let mut cont = more_after;\n        while cont {\n            let n = drain.pull(&mut buf[..CHUNK_MAX])?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                // Last chunk already emitted without CONT flag only when we\n                // saw the boundary; a zero pull while CONT is still set means\n                // framing error from the drain.\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                    &self.tmp_path,\n                    \"giant record ended while CONT flag still set\",\n                ));\n            }\n            // The drain returns a short read both at end-of-record and\n            // mid-record; distinguish by trying once more.\n            let n2 = drain.pull(&mut buf[n..CHUNK_MAX])?;\n            let total = n + n2;\n            let last = n2 == 0 || total < CHUNK_MAX;\n            self.write_chunk(if last { 0 } else { FLAG_CONT }, &buf[..total])?;\n            cont = !last;\n        }\n        self.records += 1;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Write trailer, fsync, close, then atomically rename to the final name.\n    /// Returns the committed path and record count.\n    pub fn commit(mut self, vfs: &dyn crate::io::Vfs) -> Result<(String, u64)> {\n        self.file.write_all(&self.records.to_le_bytes())?;\n        self.file.write_all(TAIL)?;\n        self.file.flush()?;\n        self.file.sync_all()?;\n        drop(self.file);\n        vfs.rename(&self.tmp_path, &self.final_path)?;\n        Ok((self.final_path, self.records))\n    }\n\n    /// Total CRC over all chunk payloads (diagnostics only).\n    pub fn payload_crc(&self) -> u32 {\n        self.crc.finish()\n    }\n}\n\n/// Decoded head of one run record.\npub struct RecordHead {\n    pub seq: u64,\n    pub nl: bool,\n    pub keys: Vec<Vec<u8>>,\n    /// Value bytes from the FIRST chunk (may be the whole small record).\n    pub prefix: Vec<u8>,\n    first_flags: u8,\n}\n\n/// Sequential run reader with per-chunk CRC verification.\npub struct RunReader {\n    file: Box<dyn VFile>,\n    path: String,\n    /// Header bytes of the chunk currently being consumed.\n    flags: u8,\n    remaining: u32,\n    chunk_crc: Crc,\n    expected_crc: u32,\n    next_is_head: bool,\n    records_seen: u64,\n    finished: bool,\n}\n\nimpl RunReader {\n    /// Open and verify the magic of a committed run.\n    pub fn open(vfs: &dyn crate::io::Vfs, path: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut file = vfs.open(path)?;\n        let mut magic = [0u8; 8];\n        read_exact_or_eof(&mut file, &mut magic, path)?;\n        if &magic != MAGIC {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(path, \"bad magic header\"));\n        }\n        Ok(RunReader {\n            file,\n            path: path.to_string(),\n            flags: 0,\n            remaining: 0,\n            chunk_crc: Crc::new(),\n            expected_crc: 0,\n            next_is_head: true,\n            records_seen: 0,\n            finished: false,\n        })\n    }\n\n    fn read_chunk_header(&mut self) -> Result<bool> {\n        let mut hdr = [0u8; HEADER_LEN];\n        match read_exact_strict(&mut self.file, &mut hdr) {\n            Ok(()) => {}\n            Err(Error::Io(e, _)) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof => return Ok(false),\n            Err(e) => return Err(e),\n        }\n        self.flags = hdr[0];\n        self.remaining = u32::from_le_bytes([hdr[1], hdr[2], hdr[3], hdr[4]]);\n        self.expected_crc = u32::from_le_bytes([hdr[5], hdr[6], hdr[7], hdr[8]]);\n        if self.remaining as usize > CHUNK_MAX {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                &self.path,\n                format!(\"chunk length {} exceeds frame max\", self.remaining),\n            ));\n        }\n        self.chunk_crc = Crc::new();\n        Ok(true)\n    }\n\n    fn pull_chunk_bytes(&mut self, dst: &mut [u8]) -> Result<usize> {\n        if self.remaining == 0 {\n            return Ok(0);\n        }\n self.expected_crc {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                &self.path,\n                \"chunk CRC mismatch — segment corrupted\",\n            ));\n        }\n        let cont = self.flags & FLAG_CONT != 0;\n        Ok(!cont)\n    }\n\n    /// Advance to the next record and decode its head. Returns `None` at the\n    /// run trailer, which is verified in [`RunReader::finish`].\n    pub fn next_head(&mut self) -> Result<Option<RecordHead>> {\n        if self.finished {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n        // If the previous record was skipped mid-stream, its value chunks must\n        // still be drained (and CRC-checked) to reach the next header.\n        loop {\n            if !self.read_chunk_header()? {\n                // EOF where a chunk header was expected: trailer should have\n                // been consumed by finish(); a bare EOF here is truncation.\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"unexpected EOF in records\"));\n            }\n            if self.flags & FLAG_FIRST != 0 {\n                break;\n            }\n            // Orphan continuation chunk from a skipped record: drain it.\n            self.drain_rest_of_chunk()?;\n        }\n\n        // Pull the entire first payload to decode the head.\n        let len = self.remaining as usize;\n        let mut payload = vec![0u8; len];\n        let mut got = 0;\n        while got < len {\n            let n = self.pull_chunk_bytes(&mut payload[got..])?;\n            got += n;\n        }\n        assert!(self.remaining == 0);\n        if self.chunk_crc.finish() != self.expected_crc {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"head chunk CRC mismatch\"));\n        }\n        let first_flags = self.flags;\n        let head = decode_head_payload(&self.path, &payload)?;\n        self.next_is_head = false;\n        self.records_seen += 1;\n        Ok(Some(head.with_flags(first_flags)))\n    }\n\n    fn drain_rest_of_chunk(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        let mut buf = [0u8; 4096];\n        while self.remaining > 0 {\n            let n = self.pull_chunk_bytes(&mut buf)?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"truncated continuation chunk\"));\n            }\n        }\n        let _ = self.chunk_finished()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Stream value bytes of the current record (after its head prefix).\n    /// Returns 0 at the end of the record. CRCs are verified chunk-by-chunk.\n    pub fn read_value(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> Result<usize> {\n        if buf.is_empty() {\n            return Ok(0);\n        }\n        // If we are positioned at a fresh continuation chunk, read its header.\n        if self.remaining == 0 {\n            if !self.read_chunk_header()? {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"EOF inside record value\"));\n            }\n            if self.flags & FLAG_FIRST != 0 {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                    &self.path,\n                    \"FIRST chunk appears before previous record ended\",\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n        let n = self.pull_chunk_bytes(buf)?;\n        if self.remaining == 0 {\n            let last = self.chunk_finished()?;\n            if last {\n                // Sentinel: signal record end by returning 0 on the NEXT call.\n                self.flags = 0;\n                self.remaining = 0;\n                // Mark a soft EOF condition distinguishable from fresh chunk:\n                // encode by returning bytes now; next call sees remaining==0,\n                // tries header read and must distinguish. Use a dedicated flag.\n                self.record_end_pending = true;\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(n)\n    }\n\n    // (field added below; see struct extension)\n    #[doc(hidden)]\n    pub fn _unused(&self) {}\n\n    /// Consume and verify the trailer (record count + tail magic).\n    pub fn finish(mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        // Drain any unconsumed tail of the last record so a corrupt chunk\n        // later in the run is still detected when callers short-circuit.\n        let mut buf = [0u8; 4096];\n        loop {\n            // Skip remainder of current chunk, then following chunks.\n            if self.remaining > 0 {\n                while self.remaining > 0 {\n                    let mut tmp = [0u8; 4096];\n                    let want = tmp.len().min(self.remaining as usize);\n                    self.pull_chunk_bytes(&mut tmp[..want])?;\n                }\n                let _ = self.chunk_finished()?;\n                self.flags = FLAG_FIRST; // force header read next\n            }\n            // Try to read another chunk; if it is a record head, drain all of\n            // that record too.\n            let present = match read_header_peek(&mut self.file) {\n                Peek::Chunk => true,\n                Peek::Trailer => false,\n                Peek::EofTruncated => {\n                    return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"truncated run trailer\"))\n                }\n            };\n            if !present {\n                break;\n            }\n            // Re-read properly through the normal path: we only peeked.\n            self._peek_back();\n            // Drain record: first chunk payload then continuation chunks.\n            if !self.read_chunk_header()? {\n HeadExt {\n    fn with_flags(self, flags: u8) -> RecordHead;\n}\n\nimpl HeadExt for HeadDecoded {\n    fn with_flags(mut self, flags: u8) -> RecordHead {\n        self.first_flags = flags;\n        RecordHead {\n            seq: self.seq,\n            nl: self.nl,\n            keys: self.keys,\n            prefix: self.prefix,\n            first_flags: flags,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstruct HeadDecoded {\n    seq: u64,\n    nl: bool,\n    keys: Vec<Vec<u8>>,\n    prefix: Vec<u8>,\n    first_flags: u8,\n}\n\nfn decode_head_payload(path: &str, p: &[u8]) -> Result<HeadDecoded> {\n    if u32::from_le_bytes(p[9..13].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;\n    let mut pos = 13;\n    let mut keys = Vec::with_capacity(key_count);\n    for _ in 0..key_count {\n        if pos + 4 > p.len() {\n read_exact_or_eof(f: &mut Box<dyn VFile>, buf: &mut [u8], path: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let mut got = 0;\n    while got < buf.len() {\n        let n = read_some(f, &mut buf[got..], path)?;\n }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn read_exact_strict(f: &mut Box<dyn VFile>, buf: &mut [u8]) -> Result<()> {\n    let mut got = 0;\n    while got < buf.len() {\n        let n = f.read(&mut buf[got..])?;\n EofTruncated,\n}\n\n/// Distinguish the trailer from a chunk header without consuming bytes is\n/// impossible on a stream; instead we read 9 bytes then reconstruct via an\n/// internal one-byte... To keep the format stream-friendly the trailer is\n/// detected by its fixed tail magic: read 16 bytes and compare.\nfn read_header_peek(_f: &mut Box<dyn VFile>) -> Peek {\n    // Replaced by Trailer-aware finish implementation below via finish_run.\n    Peek::Trailer\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::io::RealVfs;\n\n    fn tmp_dir(tag: &str) -> std::fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap();\n        d\n    }\n\n    struct SliceDrain<'a> {\n        data: &'a [u8],\n        pos: usize,\n        calls: usize,\n    }\n    impl<'a> GiantDrain for true, &[b\"key1\".to_vec()], b\"hello\").unwrap();\n        w.write_record(1, false, &[b\"key2\".to_vec()], b\"world\").unwrap();\n        let (path, n) = w.commit(&vfs).unwrap();\n  assert!(!h1.nl);\n        assert_eq!(h1.prefix, b\"world\");\n        r.finish().unwrap();\n        std::fs::remove_dir_all(&d).ok();\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn giant_record_roundtrip() {\n On-disk run-segment format and its sequential writer/reader.\n//!\n//! # Disk format\n//!\n//! A run is one *committed* (renamed + fsynced) file:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! magic   : 8 bytes  = b\"EXTSORT\\x01\"\n//! records : zero or more records, each one or more *chunks*\n//! trailer : u64 LE record count\n//! tail    : 8 bytes  = b\"ENDRUN\\x01\\x00\"\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Chunk framing (9 bytes header + payload):\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! flags   : u8        bit0 = FIRST chunk of a record\n//!                     bit1 = CONT  — more chunks follow this one\n//!                     (single-chunk record: FIRST, no CONT;\n//!                      last chunk of multi-chunk record: neither)\n//! length  : u32 LE    payload length (<= CHUNK_MAX = 16 KiB)\n//! crc32   : u32 LE    CRC-32/IEEE of the payload bytes\n//! payload : `length` bytes\n//! ```\n//!\n//! The FIRST chunk's payload is:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! u64 LE   seq             original input sequence number (stability)\n//! u8       nl              1 if the record ended with '\\n' in the input\n//! u32 LE   key_count       number of key components\n//! per key:\n//!   u32 LE key_len\n//!   bytes  key bytes\n//! bytes    value prefix (the record's own bytes, excluding '\\n')\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Later chunks contain only continuation value bytes. This layout lets a\n//! record of *unbounded* length be spilled with bounded memory: a giant line\n//! is streamed chunk-by-chunk while its (bounded) key lives in the head.\n//!\n//! Integrity: every chunk carries a CRC over its payload; the reader verifies\n//! it as the payload is consumed. The trailer repeats the record count, so a\n//! torn tail is detected. Header magic / tail magic detect wrong or\n//! truncated files.\n\nuse std::io;\n\nuse crate::crc::Crc;\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::io::VFile;\n\n/// Magic prefix of every run file.\npub const MAGIC: &[u8; 8] = b\"EXTSORT\\x01\";\n/// Magic suffix written after the record count.\npub const TAIL: &[u8; 8] = b\"ENDRUN\\x01\\x00\";\n\n/// Maximum payload bytes in one chunk.\npub const CHUNK_MAX: usize = 16 * 1024;\n/// Value bytes carried in a giant record's FIRST chunk.\npub const GIANT_HEAD_VALUE: usize = 8 * 1024;\n\nconst FLAG_FIRST: u8 = 0x01;\nconst FLAG_CONT: u8 = 0x02;\n\nconst HEADER_LEN: usize = 9;\n\n/// Trait used by [`RunWriter::write_giant`] to pull the remainder of a record\n/// that is too large to hold in memory. Implemented by the input scanner.\npub trait GiantDrain {\n    /// Copy up to `want` bytes of the current record's remainder into `buf`\n    /// (`buf.len() == want`). Returns bytes copied; fewer than `want` means the\n    /// record (and its trailing newline) has been fully consumed. May return\n    /// fewer than `want` even mid-record; callers loop.\n    fn pull(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> Result<usize>;\n}\n\n/// Sequential run writer. Drop without [`RunWriter::commit`] leaves a\n/// `*.tmp` file that recovery ignores.\npub struct RunWriter {\n    file: Box<dyn VFile>,\n    tmp_path: String,\n    final_path: String,\n    records: u64,\n    crc: Crc,\n}\n\nimpl RunWriter {\n    /// Start a new run at `<dir>/<name>.run.tmp`.\n    pub fn create(vfs: &dyn crate::io::Vfs, dir: &str, name: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let tmp_path = format!(\"{dir}/{name}.run.tmp\");\n        let final_path = format!(\"{dir}/{name}.run\");\n        let mut file = vfs.create(&tmp_path)?;\n        file.write_all(MAGIC)?;\n        Ok(RunWriter {\n            file,\n            tmp_path,\n            final_path,\n            records: 0,\n            crc: Crc::new(),\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn record_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.records\n    }\n\n    pub fn tmp_path(&self) -> &str {\n        &self.tmp_path\n    }\n\n    pub fn final_path(&self) -> &str {\n        &self.final_path\n    }\n\n    fn write_chunk(&mut self, flags: u8, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        debug_assert!(payload.len() <= CHUNK_MAX);\n        let mut crc = Crc::new();\n        crc.write(payload);\n        let mut hdr = [0u8; HEADER_LEN];\n        hdr[0] = flags;\n        hdr[1..5].copy_from_slice(&(payload.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());\n        hdr[5..9].copy_from_slice(&crc.finish().to_le_bytes());\n        self.file.write_all(&hdr)?;\n        self.file.write_all(payload)?;\n        self.crc.write(payload);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn encode_head(\n        seq: u64,\n        nl: bool,\n        keys: &[Vec<u8>],\n        value_prefix: &[u8],\n    ) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let mut p = Vec::with_capacity(\n            8 + 1 + 4 + keys.iter().map(|k| 4 + k.len()).sum::<usize>() + value_prefix.len(),\n        );\n        p.extend_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());\n        p.push(if nl { 1 } else { 0 });\n        p.extend_from_slice(&(keys.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());\n        for k in keys {\n            p.extend_from_slice(&(k.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());\n            p.extend_from_slice(k);\n        }\n        p.extend_from_slice(value_prefix);\n        p\n    }\n\n    /// Write one record that is fully resident in `value`.\n    pub fn write_record(&mut self, seq: u64, nl: bool, keys: &[Vec<u8>], value: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        if value.len()\n            <= CHUNK_MAX.saturating_sub(8 + 1 + 4 + keys.iter().map(|k| 4 + k.len()).sum::<usize>())\n        {\n            let payload = Self::encode_head(seq, nl, keys, value);\n            self.write_chunk(FLAG_FIRST, &payload)?;\n        } else {\n            // Defensive: even a fully-buffered huge value streams via chunks.\n            let head_cap = CHUNK_MAX\n                - (8 + 1 + 4 + keys.iter().map(|k| 4 + k.len()).sum::<usize>());\n            let take = head_cap.min(value.len());\n            let payload = Self::encode_head(seq, nl, keys, &value[..take]);\n            self.write_chunk(FLAG_FIRST | FLAG_CONT, &payload)?;\n            let mut rest = &value[take..];\n            while !rest.is_empty() {\n                let n = CHUNK_MAX.min(rest.len());\n                let last = n == rest.len();\n                self.write_chunk(if last { 0 } else { FLAG_CONT }, &rest[..n])?;\n                rest = &rest[n..];\n            }\n        }\n        self.records += 1;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Stream a giant record: head holds seq/keys plus up to\n    /// [`GIANT_HEAD_VALUE`] value bytes; the rest is pulled from `drain`.\n    pub fn write_giant(\n        &mut self,\n        seq: u64,\n        nl: bool,\n        keys: &[Vec<u8>],\n        prefix: &[u8],\n        drain: &mut dyn GiantDrain,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        debug_assert!(prefix.len() <= GIANT_HEAD_VALUE);\n        let overhead = 8 + 1 + 4 + keys.iter().map(|k| 4 + k.len()).sum::<usize>();\n        let head_budget = CHUNK_MAX.saturating_sub(overhead);\n        // Fill the first chunk beyond `prefix` from the drain when possible.\n        let mut first = Self::encode_head(seq, nl, keys, prefix);\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; CHUNK_MAX];\n        while first.len() < head_budget + overhead {\n            let want = (head_budget + overhead - first.len()).min(buf.len());\n            let n = drain.pull(&mut buf[..want])?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                break;\n            }\n            first.extend_from_slice(&buf[..n]);\n        }\n        let more_after = first.len() == head_budget + overhead;\n        self.write_chunk(\n            if more_after { FLAG_FIRST | FLAG_CONT } else { FLAG_FIRST },\n            &first,\n        )?;\n        let mut cont = more_after;\n        while cont {\n            let n = drain.pull(&mut buf[..CHUNK_MAX])?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                // Last chunk already emitted without CONT flag only when we\n                // saw the boundary; a zero pull while CONT is still set means\n                // framing error from the drain.\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                    &self.tmp_path,\n                    \"giant record ended while CONT flag still set\",\n                ));\n commit(mut self, vfs: &dyn crate::io::Vfs) -> Result<(String, u64)> {\n        self.file.write_all(&self.records.to_le_bytes())?;\n        self.file.write_all(TAIL)?;\n        self.file.flush()?;\n payloads (diagnostics only).\n    pub fn payload_crc(&self) -> u32 {\n        self.crc.finish()\n    }\n}\n\n/// Decoded head of one run record.\npub struct RecordHead {\n    pub seq: u64,\n    pub On-disk run-segment format and its sequential writer/reader.\n//!\n//! # Disk format\n//!\n//! A run is one *committed* (renamed + fsynced) file:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! magic   : 8 bytes  = b\"EXTSORT\\x01\"\n//! records : zero or more records, each one or more *chunks*\n//! trailer : u64 LE record count\n//! tail    : 8 bytes  = b\"ENDRUN\\x01\\x00\"\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Chunk framing (9 bytes header + payload):\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! flags   : u8        bit0 = FIRST chunk of a record\n//!                     bit1 = CONT  — more chunks follow this one\n//!                     (single-chunk record: FIRST, no CONT;\n//!                      last chunk of multi-chunk record: neither)\n//! length  : u32 LE    payload length (<= CHUNK_MAX = 16 KiB)\n//! crc32   : u32 LE    CRC-32/IEEE of the payload bytes\n//! payload : `length` bytes\n//! ```\n//!\n//! The FIRST chunk's payload is:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! u64 LE   seq             original input sequence number (stability)\n//! u8       nl              1 if the record ended with '\\n' in the input\n//! u32 LE   key_count       number of key components\n//! per key:\n//!   u32 LE key_len\n//!   bytes  key bytes\n//! bytes    value prefix (the record's own bytes, excluding '\\n')\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Later chunks contain only continuation value bytes. This layout lets a\n//! record of *unbounded* length be spilled with bounded memory: a giant line\n//! is streamed chunk-by-chunk while its (bounded) key lives in the head.\n//!\n//! Integrity: every chunk carries a CRC over its payload; the reader verifies\n//! it as the payload is consumed. The trailer repeats the record count, so a\n//! torn tail is detected. Header magic / tail magic detect wrong or\n//! truncated files.\n\nuse std::io;\n\nuse crate::crc::Crc;\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::io::VFile;\n\n/// Magic prefix of every run file.\npub const MAGIC: &[u8; 8] = b\"EXTSORT\\x01\";\n/// Magic suffix written after the record count.\npub const TAIL: &[u8; 8] = b\"ENDRUN\\x01\\x00\";\n\n/// Maximum payload bytes in one chunk.\npub const CHUNK_MAX: usize = 16 * 1024;\n/// Value bytes carried in a giant record's FIRST chunk.\npub const GIANT_HEAD_VALUE: usize = 8 * 1024;\n\nconst FLAG_FIRST: u8 = 0x01;\nconst FLAG_CONT: u8 = 0x02;\n\nconst HEADER_LEN: usize = 9;\n\n/// Trait used by [`RunWriter::write_giant`] to pull the remainder of a record\n/// that is too large to hold in memory. Implemented by the input scanner.\npub trait GiantDrain {\n    /// Copy up to `want` bytes of the current record's remainder into `buf`\n    /// (`buf.len() == want`). Returns bytes copied; fewer than `want` means the\n    /// record (and its trailing newline) has been fully consumed. May return\n    /// fewer than `want` even mid-record; callers loop.\n    fn pull(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> Result<usize>;\n}\n\n/// Sequential run writer. Drop without [`RunWriter::commit`] leaves a\n/// `*.tmp` file that recovery ignores.\npub struct RunWriter {\n    file: Box<dyn VFile>,\n    tmp_path: String,\n    final_path: String,\n    records: u64,\n    crc: Crc,\n}\n\nimpl RunWriter {\n    /// Start a new run at `<dir>/<name>.run.tmp`.\n    pub fn create(vfs: &dyn crate::io::Vfs, dir: &str, name: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let tmp_path = format!(\"{dir}/{name}.run.tmp\");\n        let final_path = format!(\"{dir}/{name}.run\");\n        let mut file = vfs.create(&tmp_path)?;\n        file.write_all(MAGIC)?;\n        Ok(RunWriter {\n            file,\n            tmp_path,\n            final_path,\n            records: 0,\n            crc: Crc::new(),\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn record_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.records\n    }\n\n    pub fn tmp_path(&self) -> &str {\n        &self.tmp_path\n    }\n\n    pub fn final_path(&self) -> &str {\n        &self.final_path\n    }\n\n    fn write_chunk(&mut {"parentUuid":"9b7d8841-9436-4777-8f54-1b2ebad842bb","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_1mcys86yxfr2ng0u7jgosptz","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp2/a/src/sortfile.rs","content":"//! On-disk run-segment format and its sequential writer/reader.\n//!\n//! # Disk format\n//!\n//! A run is one *committed* (renamed + fsynced) file:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! magic   : 8 bytes = b\"EXTSORT\\x02\"\n//! frames  : zero or more record frames\n//! trailer : frame type byte = FRAME_TRAILER, then u64 LE record count\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Every frame begins with a 1-byte discriminator so a pure sequential reader\n//! can tell records from the trailer:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! FRAME_CHUNK   = 0x10\n//! FRAME_TRAILER = 0x20\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Chunk frame layout:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! ftype   : u8        FRAME_CHUNK\n//! flags   : u8        bit0 = FIRST chunk of a record\n//!                     bit1 = CONT  — another chunk follows this one\n//!                     single-chunk record: FIRST, no CONT\n//!                     final chunk of multi-chunk record: neither bit set\n//! length  : u32 LE    payload length (<= CHUNK_MAX)\n//! crc32   : u32 LE    CRC-32/IEEE of the payload\n//! payload : `length` bytes\n//! ```\n//!\n//! The FIRST chunk payload is:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! u64 LE   seq        original input sequence number (stability tie-break)\n//! u8       nl         1 if the record ended with '\\n' in the input\n//! u32 LE   key_count  number of key components\n//! per key: u32 LE len + len key bytes\n//! bytes    value prefix (record bytes excluding the trailing '\\n')\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Later chunks hold only continuation value bytes. This lets a record of\n//! unbounded length be spilled with bounded memory: a giant line streams\n//! chunk-by-chunk while its (bounded) key stays in the head.\n//!\n//! Integrity: each chunk carries a payload CRC verified as bytes are consumed;\n//! the trailer repeats the record count, detecting torn tails; magic detects a\n//! wrong/truncated file.\n\nuse std::io;\n\nuse crate::crc::Crc;\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::io::VFile;\n\n/// Magic prefix of every run file.\npub const MAGIC: &[u8; 8] = b\"EXTSORT\\x02\";\n\nconst FRAME_CHUNK: u8 = 0x10;\nconst FRAME_TRAILER: u8 = 0x20;\n\nconst FLAG_FIRST: u8 = 0x01;\nconst FLAG_CONT: u8 = 0x02;\n\n/// Maximum payload bytes in one chunk.\npub const CHUNK_MAX: usize = 16 * 1024;\n/// Value bytes targeted for a giant record's FIRST chunk.\npub const GIANT_HEAD_VALUE: usize = 8 * 1024;\n\nconst CHUNK_HDR_LEN: usize = 1 + 1 + 4 + 4; // ftype, flags, len, crc\n\n/// Result of pulling bytes from a giant record's input source.\npub struct Pull {\n    /// Bytes made available.\n    pub bytes: usize,\n    /// True iff these bytes end the record (the trailing newline is consumed\n    /// by the drain and not included).\n    pub end_of_record: bool,\n    /// Whether the input record terminated with a newline.\n    pub nl: bool,\n}\n\n/// Source streamed by [`RunWriter::write_giant`] for an over-large record.\npub trait GiantDrain {\n    /// Fill the beginning of `buf` with up to `buf.len()` record bytes.\n    fn pull(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> Result<Pull>;\n}\n\n/// Sequential run writer. Dropping without [`RunWriter::commit`] leaves a\n/// `*.tmp` file that recovery ignores.\npub struct RunWriter {\n    file: Box<dyn VFile>,\n    tmp_path: String,\n    final_path: String,\n    records: u64,\n}\n\nimpl RunWriter {\n    pub fn create(vfs: &dyn crate::io::Vfs, dir: &str, name: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let tmp_path = format!(\"{dir}/{name}.run.tmp\");\n        let final_path = format!(\"{dir}/{name}.run\");\n        let mut file = vfs.create(&tmp_path)?;\n        file.write_all(MAGIC)?;\n        Ok(RunWriter {\n            file,\n            tmp_path,\n            final_path,\n            records: 0,\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn record_count(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.records\n    }\n    pub fn tmp_path(&self) -> &str {\n        &self.tmp_path\n    }\n    pub fn final_path(&self) -> &str {\n        &self.final_path\n    }\n\n    fn key_overhead(keys: &[Vec<u8>]) -> usize {\n        8 + 1 + 4 + keys.iter().map(|k| 4 + k.len()).sum::<usize>()\n    }\n\n    fn encode_head(seq: u64, nl: bool, keys: &[Vec<u8>], prefix: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let mut p = Vec::with_capacity(Self::key_overhead(keys) + prefix.len());\n        p.extend_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());\n        p.push(if nl { 1 } else { 0 });\n        p.extend_from_slice(&(keys.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());\n        for k in keys {\n            p.extend_from_slice(&(k.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());\n            p.extend_from_slice(k);\n        }\n        p.extend_from_slice(prefix);\n        p\n    }\n\n    fn write_chunk(&mut self, flags: u8, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        debug_assert!(payload.len() <= CHUNK_MAX);\n        let mut crc = Crc::new();\n        crc.write(payload);\n        let mut hdr = [0u8; CHUNK_HDR_LEN];\n        hdr[0] = FRAME_CHUNK;\n        hdr[1] = flags;\n        hdr[2..6].copy_from_slice(&(payload.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());\n        hdr[6..10].copy_from_slice(&crc.finish().to_le_bytes());\n        self.file.write_all(&hdr)?;\n        self.file.write_all(payload)\n    }\n\n    /// Write one fully-resident record.\n    pub fn write_record(&mut self, seq: u64, nl: bool, keys: &[Vec<u8>], value: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        let overhead = Self::key_overhead(keys);\n        if overhead + value.len() <= CHUNK_MAX {\n            let payload = Self::encode_head(seq, nl, keys, value);\n            self.write_chunk(FLAG_FIRST, &payload)?;\n        } else {\n            // Fully buffered but too big for one chunk: stream from a slice.\n            let head_value = (CHUNK_MAX - overhead).min(value.len());\n            let payload = Self::encode_head(seq, nl, keys, &value[..head_value]);\n            self.write_chunk(FLAG_FIRST | FLAG_CONT, &payload)?;\n            let mut pos = head_value;\n            while pos < value.len() {\n                let n = CHUNK_MAX.min(value.len() - pos);\n                let end = pos + n == value.len();\n                self.write_chunk(if end { 0 } else { FLAG_CONT }, &value[pos..pos + n])?;\n                pos += n;\n            }\n        }\n        self.records += 1;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Stream a giant record. `prefix` is the buffered head value; the rest is\n    /// pulled from `drain`.\n    pub fn write_giant(\n        &mut self,\n        seq: u64,\n        nl: bool,\n        keys: &[Vec<u8>],\n        prefix: &[u8],\n        drain: &mut dyn GiantDrain,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        let overhead = Self::key_overhead(keys);\n        // Assemble first payload: head + up to (CHUNK_MAX-overhead) value bytes.\n        let mut first = Self::encode_head(seq, nl, keys, prefix);\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; CHUNK_MAX];\n        let mut ended = false;\n        while first.len() < CHUNK_MAX {\n            let want = CHUNK_MAX - first.len();\n            let pull = drain.pull(&mut buf[..want])?;\n            if pull.bytes > 0 {\n                first.extend_from_slice(&buf[..pull.bytes]);\n            }\n            if pull.end_of_record {\n                ended = true;\n                break;\n            }\n            if pull.bytes == 0 {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                    &self.tmp_path,\n                    \"giant drain returned no progress and no end\",\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n        if !ended {\n            self.write_chunk(FLAG_FIRST | FLAG_CONT, &first)?;\n        } else {\n            self.write_chunk(FLAG_FIRST, &first)?;\n        }\n        while !ended {\n            let mut filled = 0;\n            let mut nl_flag = nl;\n            while filled < CHUNK_MAX {\n                let pull = drain.pull(&mut buf[filled..])?;\n                filled += pull.bytes;\n                nl_flag = pull.nl;\n                if pull.end_of_record {\n                    ended = true;\n                    break;\n                }\n                if pull.bytes == 0 {\n                    return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                        &self.tmp_path,\n                        \"giant drain stalled mid-record\",\n                    ));\n                }\n            }\n            let _ = nl_flag;\n            self.write_chunk(if ended { 0 } else { FLAG_CONT }, &buf[..filled])?;\n        }\n        self.records += 1;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Write trailer, fsync, close, atomically rename to the committed name.\n    pub fn commit(mut self, vfs: &dyn crate::io::Vfs) -> Result<(String, u64)> {\n        let mut tr = [0u8; 9];\n        tr[0] = FRAME_TRAILER;\n        tr[1..9].copy_from_slice(&self.records.to_le_bytes());\n        self.file.write_all(&tr)?;\n        self.file.flush()?;\n        self.file.sync_all()?;\n        drop(self.file);\n        vfs.rename(&self.tmp_path, &self.final_path)?;\n        Ok((self.final_path, self.records))\n    }\n}\n\n/// Decoded head of one run record.\npub struct RecordHead {\n    pub seq: u64,\n    pub nl: bool,\n    pub keys: Vec<Vec<u8>>,\n    /// Value bytes carried in the FIRST chunk (whole value for small records).\n    pub prefix: Vec<u8>,\n    /// CONT flag of the first chunk: true when value continues.\n    pub has_more: bool,\n}\n\n/// Reader position.\n#[derive(PartialEq, Eq)]\nenum Pos {\n    /// Magic verified, nothing read yet.\n    Start,\n    /// Last thing consumed was a chunk with CONT clear; next is frame type.\n    RecordBoundary,\n    /// Inside a record, `remaining` bytes of current chunk left.\n    InChunk,\n    /// Trailer frame read; nothing follows.\n    Trailer,\n}\n\n/// Sequential run reader verifying per-chunk CRCs.\npub struct RunReader {\n    file: Box<dyn VFile>,\n    path: String,\n    pos: Pos,\n    flags: u8,\n    remaining: u32,\n    crc: Crc,\n    expected_crc: u32,\n    records_seen: u64,\n}\n\nimpl RunReader {\n    pub fn open(vfs: &dyn crate::io::Vfs, path: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut file = vfs.open(path)?;\n        let mut magic = [0u8; 8];\n        read_exact(&mut file, &mut magic, path)?;\n        if &magic != MAGIC {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(path, \"bad magic header\"));\n        }\n        Ok(RunReader {\n            file,\n            path: path.to_string(),\n            pos: Pos::Start,\n            flags: 0,\n            remaining: 0,\n            crc: Crc::new(),\n            expected_crc: 0,\n            records_seen: 0,\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn path(&self) -> &str {\n        &self.path\n    }\n\n    fn read_u8(&mut self) -> Result<Option<u8>> {\n        let mut b = [0u8; 1];\n        match read_exact_opt(&mut self.file, &mut b) {\n            Ok(()) => Ok(Some(b[0])),\n            Err(Error::Io(e, _)) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof => Ok(None),\n            Err(e) => Err(e),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Read the next chunk header (called at a frame boundary). Returns false\n    /// if the trailer is found instead.\n    fn enter_frame(&mut self) -> Result<bool> {\n        let ftype = self\n            .read_u8()?\n            .ok_or_else(|| Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"EOF where frame expected\"))?;\n        if ftype == FRAME_TRAILER {\n            self.pos = Pos::Trailer;\n            return Ok(false);\n        }\n        if ftype != FRAME_CHUNK {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                &self.path,\n                format!(\"invalid frame type byte 0x{ftype:02x}\"),\n            ));\n        }\n        let mut rest = [0u8; CHUNK_HDR_LEN - 1];\n        read_exact(&mut self.file, &mut rest, &self.path)?;\n        self.flags = rest[0];\n        self.remaining = u32::from_le_bytes([rest[1], rest[2], rest[3], rest[4]]);\n        self.expected_crc = u32::from_le_bytes([rest[5], rest[6], rest[7], rest[8]]);\n        if self.remaining as usize > CHUNK_MAX {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                &self.path,\n                format!(\"chunk length {} exceeds frame max\", self.remaining),\n            ));\n        }\n        self.crc = Crc::new();\n        self.pos = Pos::InChunk;\n        Ok(true)\n    }\n\n    /// Discard the rest of the current chunk and verify its CRC.\n    fn discard_chunk_body(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        let mut buf = [0u8; 8192];\n        while self.remaining > 0 {\n            let want = buf.len().min(self.remaining as usize);\n            let n = self.file.read(&mut buf[..want])?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"chunk payload truncated\"));\n            }\n            self.crc.write(&buf[..n]);\n            self.remaining -= n as u32;\n        }\n        self.check_crc()\n    }\n\n    fn check_crc(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        if self.crc.finish() != self.expected_crc {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                &self.path,\n                \"chunk CRC mismatch — segment corrupted\",\n            ));\n        }\n        if self.flags & FLAG_CONT == 0 {\n            self.pos = Pos::RecordBoundary;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Skip every remaining chunk of the current record.\n    pub fn drain_record(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        // Current (possibly partly consumed) chunk.\n        if self.pos == Pos::InChunk {\n            self.discard_chunk_body()?;\n        }\n        // Following CONT chunks.\n        while self.flags & FLAG_CONT != 0 {\n            if !self.enter_frame()? {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"trailer inside record\"));\n            }\n            if self.flags & FLAG_FIRST != 0 {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                    &self.path,\n                    \"FIRST chunk before record ended\",\n                ));\n            }\n            self.discard_chunk_body()?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Decode the next record head. Returns None at the trailer.\n    pub fn next_head(&mut self) -> Result<Option<RecordHead>> {\n        // Finish a record the caller did not fully consume.\n        if self.pos == Pos::InChunk {\n            self.drain_record()?;\n        }\n        // At a boundary (also covers CONT chains from skipped records).\n        while self.flags & FLAG_CONT != 0 {\n            if !self.enter_frame()? {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"trailer inside record\"));\n            }\n            self.discard_chunk_body()?;\n        }\n        if !self.enter_frame()? {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n        if self.flags & FLAG_FIRST == 0 {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                &self.path,\n                \"record does not begin with a FIRST chunk\",\n            ));\n        }\n        // Pull the whole first payload (bounded by CHUNK_MAX).\n        let len = self.remaining as usize;\n        let mut payload = vec![0u8; len];\n        let mut got = 0;\n        while got < len {\n            let n = self.file.read(&mut payload[got..])?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"first chunk truncated\"));\n            }\n            self.crc.write(&payload[got..got + n]);\n            self.remaining -= n as u32;\n            got += n;\n        }\n        if self.crc.finish() != self.expected_crc {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"head chunk CRC mismatch\"));\n        }\n        let has_more = self.flags & FLAG_CONT != 0;\n        if !has_more {\n            self.pos = Pos::RecordBoundary;\n        }\n        // Stay InChunk if has_more: remaining == 0 signals \"enter next frame\".\n        let head = decode_head(&self.path, &payload)?;\n        self.records_seen += 1;\n        Ok(Some(RecordHead {\n            seq: head.seq,\n            nl: head.nl,\n            keys: head.keys,\n            prefix: head.prefix,\n            has_more,\n        }))\n    }\n\n    /// Read continuation value bytes. Returns 0 at end of record.\n    pub fn read_value(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> Result<usize> {\n        if buf.is_empty() || self.pos == Pos::RecordBoundary {\n            return Ok(0);\n        }\n        if self.remaining == 0 {\n            // Enter the next chunk of this record.\n            if !self.enter_frame()? {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"trailer inside record value\"));\n            }\n            if self.flags & FLAG_FIRST != 0 {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                    &self.path,\n                    \"FIRST chunk inside a record value\",\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n        let want = buf.len().min(self.remaining as usize);\n        let n = self.file.read(&mut buf[..want])?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"value chunk truncated\"));\n        }\n        self.crc.write(&buf[..n]);\n        self.remaining -= n as u32;\n        if self.remaining == 0 {\n            self.check_crc()?;\n        }\n        Ok(n)\n    }\n\n    /// Verify the trailer and record count. Consumes any records the caller\n    /// never visited so corruption later in a run is still caught.\n    pub fn finish(mut self) -> Result<u64> {\n        // Drain a partially consumed record.\n        if self.pos == Pos::InChunk {\n            self.drain_record()?;\n        }\n        // Walk remaining records.\n        loop {\n            let had_cont = self.flags & FLAG_CONT != 0;\n            if had_cont {\n                if !self.enter_frame()? {\n                    return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"trailer inside record\"));\n                }\n                self.drain_record()?;\n                continue;\n            }\n            if !self.enter_frame()? {\n                break; // trailer\n            }\n            if self.flags & FLAG_FIRST == 0 {\n                return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"non-first chunk at boundary\"));\n            }\n            self.discard_chunk_body()?;\n            self.drain_record()?;\n        }\n        // Trailer carries the count right after its type byte.\n        let mut count_bytes = [0u8; 8];\n        read_exact(&mut self.file, &mut count_bytes, &self.path)?;\n        let count = u64::from_le_bytes(count_bytes);\n        // Any trailing bytes are an error (trailer is the last 9 bytes).\n        if self.read_u8()?.is_some() {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(&self.path, \"bytes after trailer\"));\n        }\n        if count != self.records_seen {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                &self.path,\n                format!(\"trailer reports {count} records but {0} seen\", self.records_seen),\n            ));\n        }\n        Ok(count)\n    }\n}\n\nstruct HeadDecoded {\n    seq: u64,\n    nl: bool,\n    keys: Vec<Vec<u8>>,\n    prefix: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nfn decode_head(path: &str, p: &[u8]) -> Result<HeadDecoded> {\n    if p.len() < 13 {\n        return Err(Error::corrupt(path, \"head chunk too short\"));\n    }\n    let seq = u64::from_le_bytes(p[0..8].try_into().unwrap());\n    let nl = p[8] != 0;\n    let key_count = u32::from_le_bytes(p[9..13].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;\n    let mut pos = 13;\n    let mut keys = Vec::with_capacity(key_count);\n    for _ in 0..key_count {\n        if pos + 4 > p.len() {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(path, \"truncated key length\"));\n        }\n        let kl = u32::from_le_bytes(p[pos..pos + 4].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;\n        pos += 4;\n        if pos + kl > p.len() {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(path, \"truncated key bytes\"));\n        }\n        keys.push(p[pos..pos + kl].to_vec());\n        pos += kl;\n    }\n    Ok(HeadDecoded {\n        seq,\n        nl,\n        keys,\n        prefix: p[pos..].to_vec(),\n    })\n}\n\nfn read_exact(f: &mut Box<dyn VFile>, buf: &mut [u8], path: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    let mut got = 0;\n    while got < buf.len() {\n        let n = f.read(&mut buf[got..])?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                path,\n                format!(\"unexpected EOF (wanted {} bytes)\", buf.len()),\n            ));\n        }\n        got += n;\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn read_exact_opt(f: &mut Box<dyn VFile>, buf: &mut [u8]) -> Result<()> {\n    let mut got = 0;\n    while got < buf.len() {\n        let n = f.read(&mut buf[got..])?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(Error::io(\n                io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof, \"eof\"),\n                String::new(),\n            ));\n        }\n        got += n;\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::io::RealVfs;\n\n    fn tmp_dir(tag: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {\n        let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\"extsort-sf-{tag}-{}\", std::process::id()));\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&d);\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap();\n        d\n    }\n\n    struct SliceDrain<'a> {\n        data: &'a [u8],\n        pos: usize,\n    }\n    impl<'a> GiantDrain for SliceDrain<'a> {\n        fn pull(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> Result<Pull> {\n            // Deliberately small steps to exercise multi-chunk boundaries.\n            let step = (buf.len() / 3 + 1).min(buf.len()).min(self.data.len() - self.pos);\n            buf[..step].copy_from_slice(&self.data[self.pos..self.pos + step]);\n            self.pos += step;\n            Ok(Pull {\n                bytes: step,\n                end_of_record: self.pos == self.data.len(),\n                nl: true,\n            })\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn read_all_value(r: &mut RunReader, head: &RecordHead) -> Vec<u8> {\n        let mut out = head.prefix.clone();\n out.extend_from_slice(&buf[..z]);\n        }\n        out\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn small_records_roundtrip() {\n        let d = tmp_dir(\"small\");\n        let vfs = RealVfs::new(&d);\n b\"hello\");\n        let h1 = r.next_head().unwrap().unwrap();\n        assert!(!h1.nl);\n        assert_eq!(read_all_value(&mut r, &h1), b\"world\");\n SliceDrain { data: &big, pos: 0 };\n        w.write_giant(7, true, &[b\"k\".to_vec()], b\"abc\", &mut drain)\n            .unwrap();\n        let (path, n) = w.commit(&vfs).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(n, 1);\n\n        let mut r = RunReader::open(&vfs, &path).unwrap();\n        let h = r.next_head().unwrap().unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(h.seq, 7);\n        assert!(h.has_more);\n        let out = read_all_value(&mut r, &h);\n        assert_eq!(&out[..3], b\"abc\");\n        assert_eq!(out.len(), 3 + big.len());\n        assert!(out[3..].iter().all(|&b| b == b'x'));\n let (path, _) = w.commit(&vfs).unwrap();\n        let mut r = RunReader::open(&vfs, &path).unwrap();\n        let h = r.next_head().unwrap().unwrap();\n        assert!(!h.has_more);\n        let out = read_all_value(&mut r, &h);\n        assert_eq!(out.len(), 1 + val.len());\n        r.finish().unwrap();\n        std::fs::remove_dir_all(&d).ok();\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn empty_run_valid() {\n std::fs::remove_dir_all(&d).ok();\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn detects_crc_corruption() {\n        let d = tmp_dir(\"crc\");\n        let vfs = RealVfs::new(&d);\n        let mut w = RunWriter::create(&vfs, \".\", \"c\").unwrap();\n        w.write_record(0, true, &[b\"k\".to_vec()], b\"payload\").unwrap();\n        let (path, _) = w.commit(&vfs).unwrap();\n        let real =
