Bounded-memory input scanner.\n//!\n//! Records are lines separated by `\\n`; an optional preceding `\\r` is part of\n//! the terminator, not the value. At most `small_limit` bytes of one line are\n//! ever retained:\n//!\n//! * Short lines are returned owned as [`ScannerEvent::Small`].\n//! * A line that crosses the limit becomes a [`ScannerEvent::Giant`]: its key\n//!   columns are resolved from a bounded prefix and the caller streams the\n//!   remainder through the scanner's [`GiantDrain`] impl directly into a run\n//!   writer. The writer gets `(seq, nl, keys, prefix)`; the drain first serves\n//!   the rest of the buffered prefix, then input bytes, until the newline.\n//!\n//! Reading uses a small internal buffer whose size is included in the declared\n//! memory budget (see [`crate::budget`]).\n\nuse std::io;\n\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::key::{prefix_has_key, KeySpec};\nuse crate::sortfile::{GiantDrain, Pull};\n\n/// Input stream the scanner reads from.\npub type Input = Box<dyn io::Read + Send>;\n\n/// Internal read buffer (counted toward the memory budget).\npub const READ_BUFFER: usize = 16 * 1024;\n\n/// A record that fits inside the memory window.\npub struct SmallRecord {\n    pub line: Vec<u8>,\n    pub seq: u64,\n    pub nl: bool,\n}\n\n/// Event yielded per input record.\npub enum ScannerEvent {\n    Small(SmallRecord),\n    /// The caller must drain a giant record before calling `next` again.\n    Giant { seq: u64, nl: bool, keys: Vec<Vec<u8>>, prefix: Vec<u8> },\n    End,\n}\n\nenum Phase {\n    Line,\n    /// Draining a giant record; leftover `cur` bytes are served first.\n    GiantLeftover,\n    /// Streaming raw input for the giant record until its newline.\n    GiantStream,\n    /// Giant record finished.\n    GiantEnd,\n}\n\npub struct LineScanner {\n    input: Input,\n    readbuf: Vec<u8>,\n    read_pos: usize,\n    read_fill: usize,\n    eof: bool,\n\n    small_limit: usize,\n    spec: KeySpec,\n\n    cur: Vec<u8>,\n    seq: u64,\n    phase: Phase,\n\n    // Giant bookkeeping.\n    giant_nl: bool,\n    giant_served_leftover: bool,\n    /// While streaming, when the previous byte was '\\r' with the '\\n' pending.\n    pending_cr: bool,\n}\n\nimpl LineScanner {\n    pub fn new(input: Input, spec: KeySpec, small_limit: usize) -> Self {\n        LineScanner {\n            input,\n            readbuf: vec![0u8; READ_BUFFER],\n            read_pos: 0,\n            read_fill: 0,\n            eof: false,\n            small_limit,\n            spec,\n            cur: Vec::new(),\n            seq: 0,\n            phase: Phase::Line,\n            giant_nl: false,\n            giant_served_leftover: false,\n            pending_cr: false,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn seq(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.seq\n    }\n    pub fn spec(&self) -> &KeySpec {\n        &self.spec\n    }\n\n    fn fill_byte(&mut self) -> Result<Option<u8>> {\n        if self.read_pos >= self.read_fill {\n            if self.eof {\n                return Ok(None);\n            }\n            let n = self.input.read(&mut self.readbuf)?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                self.eof = true;\n                return Ok(None);\n            }\n            self.read_pos = 0;\n            self.read_fill = n;\n        }\n        let b = self.readbuf[self.read_pos];\n        self.read_pos += 1;\n        Ok(Some(b))\n    }\n\n    /// Scan the next record.\n    pub fn next(&mut self) -> Result<ScannerEvent> {\n        debug_assert!(\n            matches!(self.phase, Phase::Line | Phase::GiantEnd),\n            \"giant record must be drained before scanning the next record\"\n        );\n        self.cur.clear();\n        self.giant_served_leftover = false;\n        self.pending_cr = false;\n        self.giant_nl = false;\n        let seq = self.seq;\n        let mut nl = false;\n\n        loop {\n            let b = match self.fill_byte()? {\n                Some(b) => b,\n                None => break,\n            };\n            if b == b'\\n' {\n                nl = true;\n                break;\n            }\n            self.cur.push(b);\n            if self.cur.len() > self.small_limit {\n                return self.start_giant(seq);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if self.cur.is_empty() && !nl {\n            self.phase = Phase::Line;\n            return Ok(ScannerEvent::End);\n        }\n        if self.cur.last() == Some(&b'\\r') {\n            self.cur.pop();\n        }\n        self.seq += 1;\n        self.phase = Phase::Line;\n        Ok(ScannerEvent::Small(SmallRecord {\n            line: std::mem::take(&mut self.cur),\n            seq,\n            nl,\n        }))\n    }\n\n    /// Current line crossed the small-record limit. Resolve the key from a\n    /// bounded prefix and switch to giant streaming.\n    fn start_giant(&mut self, seq: u64) -> Result<ScannerEvent> {\n        if crate::key::key_needs_whole_line(&self.spec) {\n            return Err(Error::KeyTooLarge {\n                seq,\n                needed: self.cur.len(),\n                budget: self.small_limit as u64,\n            });\n        }\n        // Read until the last requested column is terminated (or line ends),\n        // retaining at most small_limit bytes. {"parentUuid":"9307efab-4b5b-4979-92fa-8631fba235c0","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"edited_text_file","filename":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp2/a/src/sortfile.rs","snippet":"1\t//! On-disk run-segment format and its sequential writer/reader.\n2\t//!\n3\t//! # Disk format\n4\t//!\n5\t//! A run is one *committed* (renamed + fsynced) file:\n6\t//!\n7\t//! ```text\n8\t//! magic   : 8 bytes = b\"EXTSORT\\x02\"\n9\t//! frames  : zero or more record frames\n10\t//! trailer : frame type byte = FRAME_TRAILER, then u64 LE record count\n11\t//! ```\n12\t//!\n13\t//! Every frame begins with a 1-byte discriminator so a pure sequential reader\n14\t//! can tell records from the trailer:\n15\t//!\n16\t//! ```text\n17\t//! FRAME_CHUNK   = 0x10\n18\t//! FRAME_TRAILER = 0x20\n19\t//! ```\n20\t//!\n21\t//! Chunk frame layout:\n22\t//!\n23\t//! ```text\n24\t//! ftype   : u8        FRAME_CHUNK\n25\t//! flags   : u8        bit0 = FIRST chunk of a record\n26\t//!                     bit1 = CONT  — another chunk follows this one\n27\t//!                     single-chunk record: FIRST, no CONT\n28\t//!                     final chunk of multi-chunk record: neither bit set\n29\t//! length  : u32 LE    payload length (<= CHUNK_MAX)\n30\t//! crc32   : u32 LE    CRC-32/IEEE of the payload\n31\t//! payload : `length` bytes\n32\t//! ```\n33\t//!\n34\t//! The FIRST chunk payload is:\n35\t//!\n36\t//! ```text\n37\t//! u64 LE   seq        original input sequence number (stability tie-break)\n38\t//! u32 LE   key_count  number of key components\n39\t//! per key: u32 LE len + len key bytes\n40\t//! bytes    value prefix (record bytes excluding the line terminator)\n41\t//! ```\n42\t//!\n43\t//! Line terminators are not persisted: output normalization adds exactly one\n44\t//! `\\n` after every emitted record (including the last).\n45\t//!\n46\t//! Later chunks hold only continuation value bytes. This lets a record of\n47\t//! unbounded length be spilled with bounded memory: a giant line streams\n48\t//! chunk-by-chunk while its (bounded) key stays in the head.\n49\t//!\n50\t//! Integrity: each chunk carries a payload CRC verified as bytes are consumed;\n51\t//! the trailer repeats the record count, detecting torn tails; magic detects a\n52\t//! wrong/truncated file.\n53\t\n54\tuse std::io;\n55\t\n56\tuse crate::crc::Crc;\n57\tuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\n58\tuse crate::io::VFile;\n59\t\n60\t/// Magic prefix of every run file.\n61\tpub const MAGIC: &[u8; 8] = b\"EXTSORT\\x02\";\n62\t\n63\tconst FRAME_CHUNK: u8 = 0x10;\n64\tconst FRAME_TRAILER: u8 = 0x20;\n65\t\n66\tconst FLAG_FIRST: u8 = 0x01;\n67\tconst FLAG_CONT: u8 = 0x02;\n68\t\n69\t/// Maximum payload bytes in one chunk.\n70\tpub const CHUNK_MAX: usize = 16 * 1024;\n71\t/// Value bytes targeted for a giant record's FIRST chunk.\n72\tpub const GIANT_HEAD_VALUE: usize = 8 * 1024;\n73\t\n74\tconst CHUNK_HDR_LEN: usize = 1 + 1 + 4 + 4; // ftype, flags, len, crc\n75\t\n76\t/// Result of pulling bytes from a giant record's input source.\n77\tpub struct Pull {\n78\t    /// Bytes made available.\n79\t    pub bytes: usize,\n80\t    /// True iff these bytes end the record (the trailing newline is consumed\n81\t    /// by the drain and not included). Whether the record ended with a newline\n82\t    /// at all is known up front by the scanner and passed to\n83\t    /// [`RunWriter::write_giant`].\n84\t    pub end_of_record: bool,\n85\t}\n86\t\n87\t/// Source streamed by [`RunWriter::write_giant`] for an over-large record.\n88\tpub trait GiantDrain {\n89\t    /// Fill the beginning of `buf` with up to `buf.len()` record bytes.\n90\t    fn pull(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> Result<Pull>;\n91\t}\n92\t\n93\t/// Sequential run writer. {"parentUuid":"b3469eed-0e84-4a82-9974-fa10e4aae6f5","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_37ubra1o0jemod0b3075p496","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp2/a/src/budget.rs","content":"//! Memory accounting.\n//!\n//! The budget explicitly **includes buffers** — it is not just the size of the\n//! records held in memory. [`Budget`] reserves fixed costs first (input read\n//! buffer, output write buffer, per-run merge buffers) and hands the engine the\n//! remaining bytes for resident records. The engine enforces the resident\n//! allowance itself; overshooting it (plus one record's worth of slack for the\n//! record currently being scanned) triggers a run flush.\n\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::scanner::READ_BUFFER;\n\n/// Hard floor below which no sort can run: read buffer + output buffer + one\n/// merge lane + room for at least a few records.\npub const MIN_BUDGET: u64 = 96 * 1024;\n\n/// Output stream write buffer.\npub const OUTPUT_BUFFER: usize = 16 * 1024;\n/// Per-merge-lane readahead buffer.\npub const MERGE_LANE_BUFFER: usize = 8 * 1024;\n/// Minimum bytes left for resident records after fixed reservations.\npub const MIN_RECORD_ALLOWANCE: usize = 4 * 1024;\n\n/// Resolved memory plan for one sort job.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\npub struct Budget {\n    /// Total bytes the job is allowed to use across all tracked buffers.\n    pub total: u64,\n    /// Resident-record allowance (what triggers a run flush).\n    pub record_allowance: usize,\n    pub read_buffer: usize,\n    pub output_buffer: usize,\n    pub lane_buffer: usize,\n}\n\nimpl Budget {\n    /// Plan a budget with a given maximum number of simultaneous merge lanes\n    /// (fan-in). Fixed buffers are reserved up front; if the budget is too\n    /// small to reserve `max_lanes` lanes, the fan-in is reduced and the merge\n    /// performs extra passes instead of exceeding the budget.\n    pub fn plan(total: u64, max_lanes: usize) -> Result<Budget> {\n        if total < MIN_BUDGET {\n            return Err(Error::BudgetTooSmall {\n                budget: total,\n                min: MIN_BUDGET,\n            });\n        }\n        let fixed = (READ_BUFFER + OUTPUT_BUFFER) as u64;\n        let mut lanes = max_lanes.max(1) as u64;\n        // Reserve lanes while enough remains for the record allowance.\n        loop {\n            let lane_bytes = lanes * MERGE_LANE_BUFFER as u64;\n            let left = total.saturating_sub(fixed + lane_bytes);\n            if left >= MIN_RECORD_ALLOWANCE as u64 || lanes == 1 {\n                break;\n            }\n            lanes -= 1;\n        }\n        let lane_bytes = lanes * MERGE_LANE_BUFFER as u64;\n        let record_allowance = (total - fixed - lane_bytes) as usize;\n        Ok(Budget {\n            total,\n            record_allowance,\n            read_buffer: READ_BUFFER,\n            output_buffer: OUTPUT_BUFFER,\n            lane_buffer: MERGE_LANE_BUFFER,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Number of merge lanes supported under this plan.\n    pub fn lanes(&self) -> usize {\n        // lane_buffer count isn't stored; recompute is done by caller via\n        // lane_count. Kept explicit below.\n        self.lane_count\n    }\n\n    /// Resident bytes currently permitted (records).\n    pub fn record_bytes(&self) -> usize {\n        self.record_allowance\n    }\n}\n\n// `lanes` field added without changing the plan() constructor call sites.\nimpl Budget {\n    // Builder used by plan().\n    pub(crate) fn with_lanes(mut self, lanes: usize) -> Self {\n        self.lane_count = lanes;\n        self\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn rejects_tiny_budget() {\n        assert!(matches!(\n            Budget::plan(1024, 8),\n            Err(Error::BudgetTooSmall { .. })\n        ));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn reserves_buffers_and_scales_lanes() {\n        let small = Budget::plan(MIN_BUDGET, 8).unwrap();\n        // At the floor, lanes must drop so records still get an allowance.\n        assert!(small.record_allowance >= MIN_RECORD_ALLOWANCE);\n        assert!(small.lanes() >= 1);\n\n Memory accounting.\n//!\n//! The budget explicitly **includes buffers** — it is not just the size of the\n//! records held in memory. [`Budget`] reserves fixed costs first (input read\n//! buffer, output write buffer, per-run merge buffers) and hands the engine the\n//! remaining bytes for resident records. The engine enforces the resident\n//! allowance itself; overshooting it (plus one record's worth of slack for the\n//! record currently being scanned) triggers a run flush.\n\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::scanner::READ_BUFFER;\n\n/// Hard floor below which no sort can run: read buffer + output buffer + one\n/// merge lane + room for at least a few records.\npub const MIN_BUDGET: u64 = 96 * 1024;\n\n/// Output stream write buffer.\npub const OUTPUT_BUFFER: usize = 16 * 1024;\n/// Per-merge-lane readahead buffer.\npub const MERGE_LANE_BUFFER: usize = 8 * 1024;\n/// Minimum bytes left for resident records after fixed reservations.\npub const MIN_RECORD_ALLOWANCE: usize = 4 * 1024;\n\n/// Resolved memory plan for one sort job.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\npub struct Budget {\n    /// Total bytes the job is allowed to use across all tracked buffers.\n    pub total: u64,\n    /// Resident-record allowance (what triggers a run flush).\n    pub record_allowance: usize,\n    pub read_buffer: usize,\n    pub output_buffer: usize,\n    pub lane_buffer: usize,\n}\n\nimpl Budget {\n    /// Plan a budget with a given maximum number of simultaneous merge lanes\n    /// (fan-in). Fixed buffers are reserved up front; if the budget is too\n    /// small to reserve `max_lanes` lanes, the fan-in is reduced and the merge\n    /// performs extra passes instead of exceeding the budget.\n    pub fn plan(total: u64, max_lanes: usize) -> Result<Budget> {\n        if total < MIN_BUDGET {\n            return Err(Error::BudgetTooSmall {\n                budget: total,\n                min: MIN_BUDGET,\n            });\n        }\n        let fixed = (READ_BUFFER + OUTPUT_BUFFER) as u64;\n        let mut lanes = max_lanes.max(1) as u64;\n        // Reserve lanes while enough remains for the record allowance.\n        loop {\n            let lane_bytes = lanes * MERGE_LANE_BUFFER as u64;\n            let left = total.saturating_sub(fixed + lane_bytes);\n            if left >= MIN_RECORD_ALLOWANCE as u64 || lanes == 1 {\n                break;\n            }\n            lanes -= 1;\n        }\n        let lane_bytes = lanes * MERGE_LANE_BUFFER as u64;\n        let record_allowance = (total - fixed - lane_bytes) as usize;\n        Ok(Budget {\n            total,\n            record_allowance,\n            read_buffer: READ_BUFFER,\n            output_buffer: OUTPUT_BUFFER,\n            lane_buffer: MERGE_LANE_BUFFER,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Number of merge lanes supported under this plan.\n    pub fn lanes(&self) -> usize {\n        // lane_buffer count isn't stored; recompute is done by caller via\n        // lane_count. Kept explicit below.\n        self.lane_count\n    }\n\n    /// Resident bytes currently permitted (records).\n    pub fn record_bytes(&self) -> usize {\n        self.record_allowance\n    }\n}\n\n// `lanes` field added without changing the plan() constructor call sites.\nimpl Budget {\n    // Builder used by plan().\n    pub(crate) fn with_lanes(mut self, lanes: usize) -> Self {\n        self.lane_count = lanes;\n        self\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn rejects_tiny_budget() {\n        assert!(matches!(\n            Budget::plan(1024, 8),\n            Err(Error::BudgetTooSmall { .. })\n        ));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn reserves_buffers_and_scales_lanes() {\n        let small = Budget::plan(MIN_BUDGET, 8).unwrap();\n        // At the floor, lanes must drop so records still get an allowance.\n        assert!(small.record_allowance >= MIN_RECORD_ALLOWANCE);\n        assert!(small.lanes() >= 1);\n\n        let big = Budget::plan(64 * 1024 * 1024, 8).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(big.lanes(), 8);\n        // Everything is accounted within the total.\n        let accounted = big.record_allowance\n            + big.read_buffer\n            + big.output_buffer\n            + big.lanes() * big.lane_buffer;\n        assert_eq!(accounted as u64, big.total);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn never_exceeds_total() {\n        for &b in &[MIN_BUDGET, 200_000u64, 1_000_000, 16 << 20] {\n            let plan = Budget::plan(b, 16).unwrap();\n            let accounted = plan.record_allowance\n                + plan.read_buffer\n                + plan.output_buffer\n                + plan.lanes() * plan.lane_buffer;\n            assert_eq!(accounted as u64, b, \"budget {b} oversubscribed\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"188d0ca4-8a4d-4d8f-a83a-4feae1af2320","session_id":"bfffd049-5085-4aad-9086-4fbcffa423da","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp2/a","sessionId":"bfffd049-5085-4aad-9086-4fbcffa423da","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp2-a","slug":"binary-squishing-zebra"}

{"parentUuid":"9b49c6d6-7c55-4511-9f40-e23ce324dd1a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_t5zn2k6fi2s7in1ezwd3e1jn","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp2/a/src/repository.rs","content":"//! File-backed job repository: on-disk layout, manifests, status files and\n//! crash recovery.\n//!\n//! # Job directory layout (under `<repo-root>/jobs/<job-id>/`)\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! input.dat                 raw input bytes (uploaded by the client)\n//! output.txt                sorted result (present once state = done)\n//! manifest.txt              durable job state (see format below)\n//! status.json               human/HTTP-facing status snapshot\n//! level0/run-00000.run      map-phase sorted segments\n//! level0/run-00001.run\n//! level1/m-1-00000.run      merge-pass outputs\n//! ...\n//! *.tmp                     uncommitted files; always deleted on recovery\n//! ```\n//!\n//! # Sync boundaries\n//!\n//! * A run is **durable but not committed** once its file has been written,\n//!   fsynced and renamed from `*.run.tmp` (the parent directory is fsynced by\n//!   [`crate::io::RealVfs::rename`]). Recovery may still delete such an orphan\n//!   run if the manifest never recorded it — the manifest is the commit point.\n//! * Every state change is: write `manifest.txt.tmp`, fsync, atomic rename to\n//!   `manifest.txt`, fsync directory. After a crash the manifest therefore\n//!   reflects a prefix of completed work; the engine resumes from exactly\n//!   that point.\n//!\n//! # Manifest text format (`manifest.txt`)\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! EXTSORT-MANIFEST/1\n//! job <id>\n//! state <map|merge|done|failed>\n//! level <n>                 # level whose runs are ready for the next action\n//! total_records <n>\n//! map_consumed <n>          # input records already written to level0\n//! spec <keys text>\n//! delim <byte>\n//! budget <bytes>\n//! max_lanes <n>\n//! run <name> <count>        # one per ready run at `level`\n//! merge_pending <name> <count>   # during merge: inputs still to merge\n//! merge_done <name> <count>      # during merge: outputs already produced\n//! ```\n\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};\n\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::io::{atomic_write_bytes, read_all, Vfs};\nuse crate::sortfile::RunReader;\n\nconst MANIFEST_NAME: &str = \"manifest.txt\";\nconst MANIFEST_TMP: &str = \"manifest.txt.tmp\";\nconst STATUS_NAME: &str = \"status.json\";\nconst STATUS_TMP: &str = \"status.json.tmp\";\nconst MANIFEST_HEADER: &str = \"EXTSORT-MANIFEST/1\";\n\n/// Job configuration supplied at creation.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct JobConfig {\n    /// Composite-key text, e.g. `1:asc,2:desc`; empty means whole line.\n    pub key_spec: String,\n    /// One-byte column delimiter.\n    pub delim: u8,\n    /// Total memory budget including buffers.\n    pub budget: u64,\n    /// Merge fan-in limit.\n    pub max_lanes: usize,\n    /// Keep intermediate level directories after success.\n    pub keep_temp: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for JobConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        JobConfig {\n            key_spec: String::new(),\n            delim: b',',\n            budget: 4 * 1024 * 1024,\n            max_lanes: 4,\n            keep_temp: false,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Coarse lifecycle state persisted in the manifest.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum JobState {\n    Map,\n    Merge,\n    Done,\n    Failed,\n}\n\nimpl JobState {\n    fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            JobState::Map => \"map\",\n            JobState::Merge => \"merge\",\n            JobState::Done => \"done\",\n            JobState::Failed => \"failed\",\n        }\n    }\n    fn parse(s: &str) -> Result<JobState> {\n        Ok(match s {\n            \"map\" => JobState::Map,\n            \"merge\" => JobState::Merge,\n            \"done\" => JobState::Done,\n            \"failed\" => JobState::Failed,\n            other => return Err(Error::InconsistentState(format!(\"unknown state {other}\"))),\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n/// One run record tracked in the manifest.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct RunEntry {\n    pub name: String,\n    pub records: u64,\n}\n\n/// Durable job state.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Manifest {\n    pub state: JobState,\n    pub level: u32,\n    pub total_records: u64,\n    pub map_consumed: u64,\n    pub runs: Vec<RunEntry>,\n    pub merge_pending: Vec<RunEntry>,\n    pub merge_done: Vec<RunEntry>,\n    pub error: String,\n}\n\nimpl Manifest {\n    fn initial() -> Manifest {\n        Manifest {\n            state: JobState::Map,\n            level: 0,\n            total_records: 0,\n            map_consumed: 0,\n            runs: Vec::new(),\n            merge_pending: Vec::new(),\n            merge_done: Vec::new(),\n            error: String::new(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// A handle to one job inside a repository.\npub struct Job {\n    pub id: String,\n    pub cfg: JobConfig,\n    pub manifest: Manifest,\n}\n\nimpl Job {\n    /// VFS-relative directory of one merge level.\n    pub fn level_dir(&self, level: u32) -> String {\n        format!(\"jobs/{}/level{}\", self.id, level)\n    }\n    pub fn run_path(&self, level: u32, name: &str) -> String {\n        format!(\"{}/{}\", self.level_dir(level), name)\n    }\n    pub fn manifest_path(&self) -> String {\n        format!(\"jobs/{}/{}\", self.id, MANIFEST_NAME)\n    }\n    pub fn input_path(&self) -> String {\n        format!(\"jobs/{}/input.dat\", self.id)\n    }\n    pub fn output_path(&self) -> String {\n        format!(\"jobs/{}/output.txt\", self.id)\n    }\n    fn status_path(&self) -> String {\n        format!(\"jobs/{}/{}\", self.id, STATUS_NAME)\n    }\n}\n\n/// The repository owns the root and the VFS implementation.\npub struct Repository {\n    root: PathBuf,\n    vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n}\n\nimpl Repository {\n    pub fn new(root: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Self {\n        let root = root.as_ref().to_path_buf();\n        let vfs = Arc::new(crate::io::RealVfs::new(&root));\n        Repository { root, vfs }\n    }\n\n    pub fn with_vfs(root: impl AsRef<Path>, vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>) -> Self {\n        Repository {\n            root: root.as_ref().to_path_buf(),\n            vfs,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn root(&self) -> &Path {\n        &self.root\n    }\n    pub fn vfs(&self) -> Arc<dyn Vfs> {\n        self.vfs.clone()\n    }\n\n    /// Create a fresh job: directory, manifest written and fsynced.\n    pub fn create_job(&self, id: &str, cfg: JobConfig) -> Result<Job> {\n        let job = Job {\n            id: id.to_string(),\n            cfg,\n            manifest: Manifest::initial(),\n        };\n        let dir = format!(\"jobs/{id}\");\n        if self.vfs.exists(&format!(\"{dir}/{MANIFEST_NAME}\")) {\n            return Err(Error::InconsistentState(format!(\"job {id} already exists\")));\n        }\n        self.vfs.make_dir_all(&job.level_dir(0))?;\n        self.commit(&job)?;\n        self.write_status(&job, \"created\")?;\n        Ok(job)\n    }\n\n    /// Load and recover a job. Orphan temp files are removed; every run named\n    /// by the manifest is integrity-checked (magic + all chunk CRCs + trailer\n    /// count). The returned job's manifest is the authoritative resume point.\n    pub fn open_job(&self, id: &str) -> Result<Job> {\n        let mpath = format!(\"jobs/{id}/{MANIFEST_NAME}\");\n        let bytes = read_all(self.vfs.as_ref(), &mpath)?;\n        let text = String::from_utf8(bytes)\n            .map_err(|_| Error::corrupt(&mpath, \"manifest is not valid UTF-8\"))?;\n        let (cfg, mut manifest) = parse_manifest(&text)\n            .map_err(|m| Error::corrupt(&mpath, m))?;\n\n        let mut job = Job {\n            id: id.to_string(),\n            cfg,\n            manifest: manifest.clone(),\n        };\n\n        self.cleanup_temps(&job)?;\n\n        // Verify every run reachable from the manifest and drop/redo handling\n        // is the caller's decision; here corruption is a hard error.\n        for run in &manifest.runs {\n            self.verify_run(&job, manifest.level, &run.name, run.records)?;\n        }\n        for run in &manifest.merge_pending {\n            self.verify_run(&job, manifest.level, &run.name, run.records)?;\n        }\n        for run in &manifest.merge_done {\n            self.verify_run(&job, manifest.level + 1, &run.name, run.records)?;\n        }\n\n        // A manifest that said \"done\" only after output exists.\n        if manifest.state == JobState::Done && !self.vfs.exists(&job.output_path()) {\n            return Err(Error::InconsistentState(\n                \"manifest says done but output.txt is missing\".into(),\n            ));\n        }\n        // If a prior attempt died in failed state, recovery does not resume it.\n        if manifest.state == JobState::Failed {\n            return Err(Error::InconsistentState(format!(\n                \"job previously failed: {}\",\n                manifest.error\n            )));\n        }\n\n        // Merge-phase resume: remove orphan outputs in the target level so the\n        // redo only sees manifest-recorded runs.\n        if manifest.state == JobState::Merge {\n            self.remove_orphan_runs(&job, manifest.level + 1, &manifest.merge_done)?;\n        }\n        // Map-phase resume: level0 contains only manifest runs; drop others.\n        if manifest.state == JobState::Map {\n            self.remove_orphan_runs(&job, 0, &manifest.runs)?;\n        }\n\n        job.manifest = manifest.clone();\n        let _ = &mut manifest;\n        self.write_status(\n            &job,\n            match job.manifest.state {\n                JobState::Map => \"resumed:map\",\n                JobState::Merge => \"resumed:merge\",\n                JobState::Done => \"done\",\n                JobState::Failed => \"failed\",\n            },\n        )?;\n        Ok(job)\n    }\n\n    fn verify_run(&self, job: &Job, level: u32, name: &str, count: u64) -> Result<()> {\n        let path = job.run_path(level, name);\n        let reader = RunReader::open(self.vfs.as_ref(), &path)?;\n        let seen = reader.finish()?;\n        if seen != count {\n            return Err(Error::corrupt(\n                path,\n                format!(\"manifest records {count} rows, file contains {seen}\"),\n            ));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Delete all `*.tmp` / `*.run.tmp` files under the job tree.\n    fn cleanup_temps(&self, job: &Job) -> Result<()> {\n        for ent in self.vfs.list_dir(&format!(\"jobs/{}\", job.id))? {\n            if ent.is_file && (ent.name.ends_with(\".tmp\")) {\n                self.vfs\n                    .remove(&format!(\"jobs/{}/{}\", job.id, ent.name))?;\n            }\n        }\n        for level in 0..=32 {\n            let dir = job.level_dir(level);\n            if !self.vfs.exists(&dir) {\n                if level == 0 {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                break;\n            }\n            for ent in self.vfs.list_dir(&dir)? {\n                if ent.is_file && ent.name.ends_with(\".tmp\") {\n                    self.vfs.remove(&format!(\"{dir}/{}\", ent.name))?;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn remove_orphan_runs(&self, job: &Job, level: u32, keep: &[RunEntry]) -> Result<()> {\n        let dir = job.level_dir(level);\n        if !self.vfs.exists(&dir) {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        for ent in self.vfs.list_dir(&dir)? {\n            if !ent.is_file || !ent.name.ends_with(\".run\") {\n                continue;\n            }\n            if !keep.iter().any(|r| r.name == ent.name) {\n                self.vfs.remove(&format!(\"{dir}/{}\", ent.name))?;\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Persist the manifest (atomic, fsynced) and refresh status.\n    pub fn commit(&self, job: &Job) -> Result<()> {\n        let body = serialize_manifest(job);\n        atomic_write_bytes(\n            self.vfs.as_ref(),\n            &format!(\"jobs/{}/{}\", job.id, commit_with_status(&self, job: &Job, note: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        self.commit(job)?;\n        self.write_status(job, note)\n    }\n\n    /// Mark failure durably (best effort; errors here are ignored).\n    pub fn mark_failed(&self, job: &mut Job, error: &str) {\n        job.manifest.state = JobState::Failed;\n        job.manifest.error = error.to_string();\n        let _ = self.commit(job);\n        let _ = self.write_status(job, \"failed\");\n    }\n\n    fn write_status(&self, job: &Job, note: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        let body = status_json(job, note);\n        atomic_write_bytes(\n            self.vfs.as_ref(),\n            &format!(\"jobs/{}/{}\", job.id, STATUS_TMP),\n            &job.status_path(),\n            body.as_bytes(),\n        )\n    }\n\n    /// Read a job's status.json without full recovery checks.\n    pub fn read_status(&self, id: &str) -> Result<String> {\n        let p = format!(\"jobs/{id}/{STATUS_NAME}\");\n        let bytes = read_all(self.vfs.as_ref(), &p)?;\n        Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes).into_owned())\n    }\n\n    /// Enumerate job ids (directory names under `jobs/`).\n    pub fn list_jobs(&self) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        for ent in self.vfs.list_dir(\"jobs\")? {\n            if !ent.is_file && self.vfs.exists(&format!(\"jobs/{}/{}\", ent.name, MANIFEST_NAME)) {\n                out.push(ent.name);\n            }\n        }\n        out.sort();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n\n    /// Remove a completed job's intermediate level directories (output and\n    /// manifest are retained).\n    pub fn cleanup_levels(&self, job: &Job) -> Result<()> {\n        for level in 0..=64u32 {\n            let dir = job.level_dir(level);\n            if !self.vfs.exists(&dir) {\n                break;\n            }\n            for ent in self.vfs.list_dir(&dir)? {\n                if ent.is_file {\n                    self.vfs.remove(&format!(\"{dir}/{}\", ent.name))?;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ---- manifest (de)serialization -------------------------------------------\n\nfn serialize_manifest(job: &Job) -> String {\n    let m = &job.manifest;\n    let mut s = String::new();\n    s.push_str(MANIFEST_HEADER);\n    s.push('\\n');\n    s.push_str(&format!(\"job {}\\n\", job.id));\n    s.push_str(&format!(\"state {}\\n\", m.state.as_str()));\n    s.push_str(&format!(\"level {}\\n\", m.level));\n    s.push_str(&format!(\"total_records {}\\n\", m.total_records));\n    s.push_str(&format!(\"map_consumed {}\\n\", m.map_consumed));\n    s.push_str(&format!(\"spec {}\\n\", encode_one(&job.cfg.key_spec)));\n    s.push_str(&format!(\"delim {}\\n\", job.cfg.delim));\n    s.push_str(&format!(\"budget {}\\n\", job.cfg.budget));\n    s.push_str(&format!(\"max_lanes {}\\n\", job.cfg.max_lanes));\n    s.push_str(&format!(\"keep_temp {}\\n\", job.cfg.keep_temp as u8));\n    for r in &m.runs {\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"run {} {}\\n\", encode_one(&r.name), r.records));\n    }\n    for r in &m.merge_pending {\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"merge_pending {} {}\\n\", encode_one(&r.name), r.records));\n    }\n    for r in &m.merge_done {\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"merge_done {} {}\\n\", encode_one(&r.name), r.records));\n    }\n    if !m.error.is_empty() {\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"error {}\\n\", encode_one(&m.error)));\n    }\n    s\n}\n\nfn parse_manifest(text: &str) -> std::result::Result<(JobConfig, Manifest), String> {\n    let mut lines = text.lines();\n    let header = lines.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    if header != MANIFEST_HEADER {\n        return Err(format!(\"bad manifest header: {header:?}\"));\n    }\n    let mut cfg = JobConfig::default();\n    let mut m = Manifest::initial();\n    let mut job_id = String::new();\n    for line in lines {\n        if line.is_empty() {\n            continue;\n        }\n        let (key, rest) = line.split_once(' ').unwrap_or((line, \"\"));\n        match key {\n            \"job\" => job_id = rest.to_string(),\n            \"state\" => m.state = JobState::parse(rest).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?,\n            \"level\" => m.level = rest.parse().map_err(|_| \"bad level\")?,\n            \"total_records\" => m.total_records = rest.parse().map_err(|_| \"bad total\")?,\n            \"map_consumed\" => m.map_consumed = rest.parse().map_err(|_| \"bad map_consumed\")?,\n            \"spec\" => cfg.key_spec = decode_one(rest),\n            \"delim\" => cfg.delim = rest.parse().map_err(|_| \"bad delim\")?,\n            \"budget\" => cfg.budget = rest.parse().map_err(|_| \"bad budget\")?,\n            \"max_lanes\" => cfg.max_lanes = rest.parse().map_err(|_| \"bad max_lanes\")?,\n            \"keep_temp\" => cfg.keep_temp = rest == \"1\",\n            \"run\" => {\n                let (name, count) = parse_run(rest)?;\n                m.runs.push(RunEntry {\n                    name: decode_one(name),\n                    records: count,\n                });\n            }\n            \"merge_pending\" => {\n                let (name, count) = parse_run(rest)?;\n                m.merge_pending.push(RunEntry {\n                    name: decode_one(name),\n                    records: count,\n                });\n            }\n            \"merge_done\" => {\n                let (name, count) = parse_run(rest)?;\n                m.merge_done.push(RunEntry {\n                    name: decode_one(name),\n                    records: count,\n                });\n            }\n            \"error\" => m.error = decode_one(rest),\n            other => return Err(format!(\"unknown manifest key: {other}\")),\n        }\n    }\n    if job_id.is_empty() {\n        return Err(\"manifest missing job id\".into());\n    }\n    Ok((cfg, m))\n}\n\nfn parse_run(rest: &str) -> std::result::Result<(&str, u64), String> {\n    let (name, count) = rest\n        .rsplit_once(' ')\n        .ok_or_else(|| \"malformed run line\".to_string())?;\n    let count = count.parse().map_err(|_| \"bad run count\")?;\n    Ok((name, count))\n}\n\n/// Percent-encode spaces and `%` so values remain single whitespace-free\n/// tokens in the line format.\nfn encode_one(s: &str) -> String {\n    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len());\n    for b in s.bytes() {\n        match b {\n            b' ' => out.push_str(\"%20\"),\n            b'%' => out.push_str(\"%25\"),\n            b'\\n' => out.push_str(\"%0A\"),\n            _ => out.push(b as char),\n        }\n    }\n    out\n}\n\nfn decode_one(s: &str) -> String {\n    let bytes = s.as_bytes();\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len());\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        if bytes[i] == b'%' && i + 2 < bytes.len() {\n            let h = std::str::from_utf8(&bytes[i + 1..i + 3]).unwrap_or(\"\");\n            match u8::from_str_radix(h, 16) {\n                Ok(v) => {\n                    out.push(v);\n                    i += 3;\n                    continue;\n                }\n                Err(_ => {}\n            }\n        }\n        out.push(bytes[i]);\n        i += 1;\n    }\n    String::from_utf8_lossy(&out).into_owned()\n}\n\n// ---- status JSON -----------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn status_json(job: &Job, note: &str) -> String {\n    let m = &job.manifest;\n    let now = SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .map(|d| d.as_secs())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n    format!(\n        \"{{\\\"job_id\\\":\\\"{}\\\",\\\"state\\\":\\\"{}\\\",\\\"note\\\":\\\"{}\\\",\\\"level\\\":{},\\\"total_records\\\":{},\\\"map_consumed\\\":{},\\\"ready_runs\\\":{},\\\"merge_pending\\\":{},\\\"merge_done\\\":{},\\\"output\\\":\\\"jobs/{}/output.txt\\\",\\\"updated_unix\\\":{}}}\\n\",\n        json_escape(&job.id),\n        m.state.as_str(),\n        json_escape(note),\n        m.level,\n        m.total_records,\n        m.map_consumed,\n        m.runs.len(),\n        m.merge_pending.len(),\n        m.merge_done.len(),\n        json_escape(&job.id),\n        now,\n    )\n}\n\npub fn json_escape(s: &str) -> String {\n    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len());\n    for c in s.chars() {\n        match c {\n            '\"' => out.push_str(\"\\\\\\\"\"),\n            '\\\\' => out.push_str(\"\\\\\\\\\"),\n            '\\n' => out.push_str(\"\\\\n\"),\n            '\\r' => out.push_str(\"\\\\r\"),\n            '\\t' => out.push_str(\"\\\\t\"),\n            c if (c as u32) < 0x20 => out.push_str(&format!(\"\\\\u{:04x}\", c as u32)),\n            c => out.push(c),\n        }\n    }\n    out\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn manifest_roundtrip() {\n        let cfg = JobConfig {\n            key_spec: \"1:asc,2:desc\".into(),\n            delim: b'|',\n            budget: 123_456,\n            max_lanes: 5,\n            keep_temp: true,\n        };\n        let mut job = Job {\n            id: \"job-42\".into(),\n            cfg,\n            manifest: Manifest::initial(),\n        };\n        job.manifest.state = JobState::Merge;\n        job.manifest.level = 1;\n        job.manifest.total_records = 99;\n        job.manifest.map_consumed = 99;\n        job.manifest.runs = vec![RunEntry {\n            name: \"m-1-00000.run\".into(),\n            records: 99,\n        }];\n        let text = serialize_manifest(&job);\n        let (cfg2, m2) = parse_manifest(&text).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(cfg2.key_spec, \"1:asc,2:desc\");\n        assert_eq!(cfg2.delim, assert_eq!(m2.level, 1);\n        assert_eq!(m2.runs[0].name, \"m-1-00000.run\");\n        assert_eq!(m2.runs[0].records, 99);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn encode_tokens_with_spaces() {\n        assert_eq!(encode_one(\"a b%c\"), \"a%20b%25c\");\n        assert_eq!(decode_one(\"a%20b%25c\"), \"a b%c\");\n File-backed job repository: on-disk layout, manifests, status files and\n//! crash recovery.\n//!\n//! # Job directory layout (under `<repo-root>/jobs/<job-id>/`)\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! input.dat                 raw input bytes (uploaded by the client)\n//! output.txt                sorted result (present once state = done)\n//! manifest.txt              durable job state (see format below)\n//! status.json               human/HTTP-facing status snapshot\n//! level0/run-00000.run      map-phase sorted segments\n//! level0/run-00001.run\n//! level1/m-1-00000.run      merge-pass outputs\n//! ...\n//! *.tmp                     uncommitted files; always deleted on recovery\n//! ```\n//!\n//! # Sync boundaries\n//!\n//! * A run is **durable but not committed** once its file has been written,\n//!   fsynced and renamed from `*.run.tmp` (the parent directory is fsynced by\n//!   [`crate::io::RealVfs::rename`]). Recovery may still delete such an orphan\n//!   run if the manifest never recorded it — the manifest is the commit point.\n//! * Every state change is: write `manifest.txt.tmp`, fsync, atomic rename to\n//!   `manifest.txt`, fsync directory. After a crash the manifest therefore\n//!   reflects a prefix of completed work; the engine resumes from exactly\n//!   that point.\n//!\n//! # Manifest text format (`manifest.txt`)\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! EXTSORT-MANIFEST/1\n//! job <id>\n//! state <map|merge|done|failed>\n//! level <n>                 # level whose runs are ready for the next action\n//! total_records <n>\n//! map_consumed <n>          # input records already written to level0\n//! spec <keys text>\n//! delim <byte>\n//! budget <bytes>\n//! max_lanes <n>\n//! run <name> <count>        # one per ready run at `level`\n//! merge_pending <name> <count>   # during merge: inputs still to merge\n//! merge_done <name> <count>      # during merge: outputs already produced\n//! ```\n\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};\n\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::io::{atomic_write_bytes, read_all, Vfs};\nuse crate::sortfile::RunReader;\n\nconst MANIFEST_NAME: &str = \"manifest.txt\";\nconst MANIFEST_TMP: &str = \"manifest.txt.tmp\";\nconst STATUS_NAME: &str = \"status.json\";\nconst STATUS_TMP: &str = \"status.json.tmp\";\nconst MANIFEST_HEADER: &str = \"EXTSORT-MANIFEST/1\";\n\n/// Job configuration supplied at creation.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct JobConfig {\n    /// Composite-key text, e.g. `1:asc,2:desc`; empty means whole line.\n    pub key_spec: String,\n    /// One-byte column delimiter.\n    pub delim: u8,\n    /// Total memory budget including buffers.\n    pub budget: u64,\n    /// Merge fan-in limit.\n    pub max_lanes: usize,\n    /// Keep intermediate level directories after success.\n    pub keep_temp: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for JobConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        JobConfig {\n            key_spec: String::new(),\n            delim: b',',\n            budget: 4 * 1024 * 1024,\n            max_lanes: 4,\n            keep_temp: false,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Coarse lifecycle state persisted in the manifest.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum JobState {\n    Map,\n    Merge,\n    Done,\n    Failed,\n}\n\nimpl JobState {\n    fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            JobState::Map => \"map\",\n            JobState::Merge => \"merge\",\n            JobState::Done => \"done\",\n            JobState::Failed => \"failed\",\n        }\n    }\n    fn parse(s: &str) -> Result<JobState> {\n        Ok(match s {\n            \"map\" => JobState::Map,\n            \"merge\" => JobState::Merge,\n            \"done\" => JobState::Done,\n            \"failed\" => JobState::Failed,\n            other => return Err(Error::InconsistentState(format!(\"unknown state {other}\"))),\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n/// One run record tracked in the manifest.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct RunEntry {\n    pub name: String,\n    pub records: u64,\n}\n\n/// Durable job state.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Manifest {\n    pub state: JobState,\n    pub level: u32,\n    pub total_records: u64,\n    pub map_consumed: u64,\n    pub runs: Vec<RunEntry>,\n    pub merge_pending: Vec<RunEntry>,\n    pub merge_done: Vec<RunEntry>,\n    pub error: String,\n}\n\nimpl Manifest {\n    fn initial() -> Manifest {\n        Manifest {\n            state: JobState::Map,\n            level: 0,\n            total_records: 0,\n            map_consumed: 0,\n            runs: Vec::new(),\n            merge_pending: Vec::new(),\n            merge_done: Vec::new(),\n            error: String::new(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// A handle to one job inside a repository.\npub struct Job {\n    pub id: String,\n    pub cfg: JobConfig,\n    pub manifest: Manifest,\n}\n\nimpl Job {\n    /// VFS-relative directory of one merge level.\n    pub fn level_dir(&self, level: u32) -> String {\n        format!(\"jobs/{}/level{}\", self.id, level)\n    }\n    pub fn run_path(&self, level: u32, name: &str) -> String {\n        format!(\"{}/{}\", self.level_dir(level), name)\n    }\n    pub fn manifest_path(&self) -> String {\n        format!(\"jobs/{}/{}\", self.id, MANIFEST_NAME)\n    }\n    pub fn input_path(&self) -> String {\n        format!(\"jobs/{}/input.dat\", self.id)\n    }\n    pub fn output_path(&self) -> String {\n        format!(\"jobs/{}/output.txt\", self.id)\n    }\n    fn status_path(&self) -> String {\n        format!(\"jobs/{}/{}\", self.id, STATUS_NAME)\n    }\n}\n\n/// The repository owns the root and the VFS implementation.\npub struct Repository {\n    root: PathBuf,\n    vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>,\n}\n\nimpl Repository {\n    pub fn new(root: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Self {\n        let root = root.as_ref().to_path_buf();\n        let vfs = Arc::new(crate::io::RealVfs::new(&root));\n        Repository { root, vfs }\n    }\n\n    pub fn with_vfs(root: impl AsRef<Path>, vfs: Arc<dyn Vfs>) -> Self {\n        Repository {\n            root: root.as_ref().to_path_buf(),\n            vfs,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn root(&self) -> &Path {\n        &self.root\n    }\n    pub fn vfs(&self) -> Arc<dyn Vfs> {\n        self.vfs.clone()\n    }\n\n    /// Create a fresh job: directory, manifest written and fsynced.\n    pub fn create_job(&self, id: &str, cfg: JobConfig) -> Result<Job> {\n        let job = Job {\n            id: id.to_string(),\n            cfg,\n            manifest: Manifest::initial(),\n        };\n        let dir = format!(\"jobs/{id}\");\n        if self.vfs.exists(&format!(\"{dir}/{MANIFEST_NAME}\")) {\n            return Err(Error::InconsistentState(format!(\"job {id} already exists\")));\n        }\n        self.vfs.make_dir_all(&job.level_dir(0))?;\n        self.commit(&job)?;\n        self.write_status(&job, \"created\")?;\n        Ok(job)\n    }\n\n    /// Load and recover a job. Orphan temp files are removed; every run named\n    /// by the manifest is integrity-checked (magic + all chunk CRCs + trailer\n    /// count). The returned job's manifest is the authoritative resume point.\n    pub fn open_job(&self, id: &str) -> Result<Job> {\n        let mpath = format!(\"jobs/{id}/{MANIFEST_NAME}\");\n        let bytes = read_all(self.vfs.as_ref(), &mpath)?;\n        let text = String::from_utf8(bytes)\n            .map_err(|_| Error::corrupt(&mpath, \"manifest is not valid UTF-8\"))?;\n        let (cfg, mut manifest) manifest;\n        self.write_status(\n            &job,\n            match job.manifest.state {\n                JobState::Map => \"resumed:map\",\n                JobState::Merge => Recovery may still delete such an orphan\n//!   run if the manifest never recorded it — the manifest is the commit point.\n//! * Every state change is: write `manifest.txt.tmp`, fsync, atomic rename to\n//!   `manifest.txt`, fsync directory. After a crash the manifest therefore\n//!   reflects a prefix of completed work; the engine resumes from exactly\n//!   that point.\n//!\n//! # Manifest text format (`manifest.txt`)\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! EXTSORT-MANIFEST/1\n//! job <id>\n//! state <map|merge|done|failed>\n//! level <n>                 # level whose runs are ready for the next action\n//! total_records <n>\n//! map_consumed <n>          # input records already written to level0\n//! spec <keys text>\n//! delim <byte>\n//! budget <bytes>\n//! max_lanes <n>\n//! run <name> <count>        # one per ready run at `level`\n//! merge_pending <name> <count>   # during merge: inputs still to merge\n//! merge_done <name> <count>      # during merge: outputs already produced\n//! ```\n\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};\n\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::io::{atomic_write_bytes, read_all, Vfs};\nuse crate::sortfile::RunReader;\n\nconst MANIFEST_NAME: &str = \"manifest.txt\";\nconst MANIFEST_TMP: &str = \"manifest.txt.tmp\";\nconst STATUS_NAME: &str = \"status.json\";\nconst STATUS_TMP: &str = \"status.json.tmp\";\nconst MANIFEST_HEADER: &str = \"EXTSORT-MANIFEST/1\";\n\n/// Job configuration supplied at creation.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct JobConfig {\n    /// Composite-key text, e.g. `1:asc,2:desc`; empty means whole line.\n    pub key_spec: String,\n    /// One-byte column delimiter.\n    pub delim: u8,\n    /// Total memory budget including buffers.\n    pub budget: u64,\n    /// Merge fan-in limit.\n    pub max_lanes: usize,\n    /// Keep intermediate level directories after success.\n    pub keep_temp: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for JobConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n Coarse lifecycle state persisted in the manifest.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum JobState {\n    Map,\n    Merge,\n    Done,\n    Failed,\n}\n\nimpl JobState {\n    fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            JobState::Map => \"map\",\n            JobState::Merge => \"merge\",\n            JobState::Done => \"done\",\n            JobState::Failed => \"failed\",\n        }\n    }\n    fn parse(s: &str) -> Result<JobState> {\n        Ok(match s {\n            \"map\" => JobState::Map,\n            \"merge\" => JobState::Merge,\n            \"done\" => JobState::Done,\n            \"failed\" => JobState::Failed,\n            other => return Err(Error::InconsistentState(format!(\"unknown state {other}\"))),\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n/// One run record tracked in the manifest.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct RunEntry {\n    pub name: String,\n    pub records: u64,\n}\n\n/// Durable job state.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Manifest {\n    pub state: JobState,\n    pub level: u32,\n    pub total_records: u64,\n    pub map_consumed: u64,\n    pub runs: Vec<RunEntry>,\n    pub merge_pending: level: 0,\n            total_records: 0,\n            map_consumed: 0,\n            runs: Vec::new(),\n            merge_pending: Vec::new(),\n            merge_done: Vec::new(),\n            error: fn status_path(&self) -> String {\n        format!(\"jobs/{}/{}\", self.id, STATUS_NAME)\n    }\n}\n\n/// The repository owns the root and the VFS implementation.\npub struct Repository {\n    root: }\n\n    /// Create a fresh job: directory, manifest written and fsynced.\n    pub fn create_job(&self, id: &str, cfg: JobConfig) -> Result<Job> {\n        let job = Job {\n            id: The returned job's manifest is the authoritative resume point.\n    pub fn open_job(&self, id: &str) -> Result<Job> {\n        let mpath = format!(\"jobs/{id}/{MANIFEST_NAME}\");\n        let bytes = read_all(self.vfs.as_ref(), &mpath)?;\n        let text = String::from_utf8(bytes)\n            .map_err(|_| Error::corrupt(&mpath, \"manifest is not valid UTF-8\"))?;\n        let (cfg, mut manifest) manifest.clone(),\n        };\n\n        self.cleanup_temps(&job)?;\n\n        // Verify every run reachable from the manifest and drop/redo handling\n        // is the caller's decision; here corruption is a hard error.\n        for run in &manifest.runs {\n            self.verify_run(&job, manifest.level, &run.name, run.records)?;\n        }\n        for run in &manifest.merge_pending {\n            self.verify_run(&job, manifest.level, &run.name, run.records)?;\n        }\n        for run in &manifest.merge_done {\n            self.verify_run(&job, manifest.level + 1, &run.name, &Job, level: u32, name: &str, count: u64) -> Result<()> {\n        let path = job.run_path(level, name);\n        let reader = RunReader::open(self.vfs.as_ref(), &path)?;\n        let seen =     ));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Delete all `*.tmp` / `*.run.tmp` files under the job tree.\n    fn cleanup_temps(&self, job: &Job) -> Result<()> {\n        for ent in Memory accounting.\n//!\n//! The budget explicitly **includes buffers** — it is not just the size of the\n//! records held in memory. [`Budget::plan`] reserves fixed costs first (input\n//! read buffer, output write buffer, per-run merge buffers) and hands the\n//! engine the remaining bytes for resident records. The engine flushes a run\n//! whenever resident records approach that allowance.\n\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::scanner::READ_BUFFER;\n\n/// Hard floor below which no sort can run: read buffer + output buffer + one\n/// merge lane + room for at least a few records.\npub const MIN_BUDGET: u64 = 96 * 1024;\n\n/// Output stream write buffer.\npub const OUTPUT_BUFFER: usize = 16 * 1024;\n/// Per-merge-lane readahead buffer.\npub const MERGE_LANE_BUFFER: usize = 8 * 1024;\n/// Minimum bytes left for resident records after fixed reservations.\npub const MIN_RECORD_ALLOWANCE: usize = 4 * 1024;\n\n/// Resolved memory plan for one sort job.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\npub struct Budget {\n    /// Total bytes the job is allowed to use across all tracked buffers.\n    pub total: u64,\n    /// Resident-record allowance (what triggers a run flush).\n    pub record_allowance: usize,\n    pub read_buffer: usize,\n    pub output_buffer: usize,\n    pub lane_buffer: usize,\n    /// Merge fan-in supported under this budget (extra passes if reduced).\n    pub lane_count: usize,\n}\n\nimpl Budget {\n    /// Plan a budget with a target maximum number of simultaneous merge lanes.\n    /// Fixed buffers are reserved first; if the budget cannot fund\n    /// `max_lanes` lanes plus [`MIN_RECORD_ALLOWANCE`], lanes are reduced (the\n    /// merge then performs extra passes) rather than exceeding the budget.\n    pub fn plan(total: u64, max_lanes: usize) -> Result<Budget> {\n        if total < MIN_BUDGET {\n            return Err(Error::BudgetTooSmall {\n                budget: total,\n                min: MIN_BUDGET,\n            });\n        }\n        let fixed = (READ_BUFFER + OUTPUT_BUFFER) as u64;\n        let mut lanes = (max_lanes.max(1)) as u64;\n        loop {\n            let lane_bytes = lanes * MERGE_LANE_BUFFER as u64;\n            let left = total.saturating_sub(fixed + lane_bytes);\n            if left >= MIN_RECORD_ALLOWANCE as u64 || lanes == 1 {\n                break;\n            }\n            lanes -= 1;\n        }\n        let lane_bytes = lanes * MERGE_LANE_BUFFER as u64;\n        let record_allowance = (total - fixed - lane_bytes) as usize;\n        Ok(Budget {\n            total,\n            record_allowance,\n            read_buffer: READ_BUFFER,\n            output_buffer: OUTPUT_BUFFER,\n            lane_buffer: MERGE_LANE_BUFFER,\n            lane_count: lanes as usize,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Number of simultaneous merge lanes supported under this plan.\n    pub fn lanes(&self) -> usize {\n        self.lane_count\n    }\n\n    /// Resident bytes permitted for in-memory records.\n    pub fn record_bytes(&self) -> usize {\n        self.record_allowance\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn rejects_tiny_budget() {\n        assert!(matches!(\n            Budget::plan(1024, 8),\n            Err(Error::BudgetTooSmall { .. })\n        ));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn reserves_buffers_and_scales_lanes() {\n        let small = Budget::plan(MIN_BUDGET, 8).unwrap();\n        assert!(small.record_allowance >= MIN_RECORD_ALLOWANCE);\n        assert!(small.lanes() >= 1);\n\n        let big = Budget::plan(64 * 1024 * 1024, 8).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(big.lanes(), 8);\n        let accounted = big.record_allowance\n            + big.read_buffer\n            + big.output_buffer\n            + big.lanes() * big.lane_buffer;\n        assert_eq!(accounted as u64, big.total);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn never_exceeds_total() {\n plan.read_buffer\n                + plan.output_buffer\n                + plan.lanes() * plan.lane_buffer;\n            assert_eq!(accounted as u64, b, \"budget {b} oversubscribed\");\n        }\n
